vagas.title: Manager, Ceremonies
vagas.description: Department: Events & Entertainment Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre-production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations. Escalate ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day-to-day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards. Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—suppliers, freelancers, and event-time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Contribute to coordination between venue-based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team. Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner. Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies. Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements. Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony-related content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Coordinate with multiple suppliers and conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Support the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and provide operational support on event days. Support operational decision-making to help maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist with rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Support venue level preproduction activities, including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Ceremonies Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day-to-day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalute risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as a liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE, in coordination with the Senior Manager. Deliver concise briefings and alignment updates across all internal and external stakeholders. Support the building and maintenance of relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Support preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and support execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Assist in rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre-event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments. FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem-solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross-functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista Inteligência Comercial - Rio de Janeiro, RJ
vagas.description: A Knauf é sinônimo de oportunidade. Sabemos que a oportunidade é diferente para cada pessoa e temos orgulho de ver possibilidades em todos. Esta posição na Knauf Brasil pode ser perfeita para você desenvolver uma carreira única em uma cultura baseada em valores, com o objetivo de fazer do amanhã um lar para todos nós. Somos um fabricante global de materiais de construção e nossos 41.500 membros presentes em 90 países e em 300 locais diferentes oferecem uma grande oportunidade para qualquer pessoa com ambição e energia. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos e pedimos que tragam todo o seu potencial para o trabalho, para enriquecer ainda mais o negócio, pois juntos alcançamos mais em um ambiente seguro e inclusivo. A expansão do nosso time significa que agora estamos procurando uma pessoa para ocupar a função de ANALISTA INTELIGÊNCIA COMERCIAL para o RIO DE JANEIRO, RJ, reportando-se a COORDENAÇÃO EXCELÊNCIA COMERCIAL. Você pode dizer sim? Você trata seus colegas com respeito? Você sempre pensa no cliente? Você age pensando nas gerações futuras? Você tem um histórico comprovado de resultados? Se sim, gostaríamos de ouvir sua opinião. Nesta posição, você irá realizar atividades na área de inteligência comercial, relativas à coleta, consolidação e análise de informações sobre atividades de vendas, mercado e concorrentes, gerir operacionalmente os preços de todos os produtos da Knauf e elaborar reportes de dados para a alta gestão. O que você fará? Gestão e revisão contínua de preços e margens. Construção de análises estratégicas relacionadas à política comercial. Avaliação de impactos tributários na composição de preços. Suporte à governança de pricing e políticas de desconto. Participação em projetos e melhorias relacionadas ao SAP – módulo SD. Desenvolvimento de relatórios, dashboards e análises gerenciais. Interface com áreas como Comercial, Financeiro, Diretoria e times internacionais. Identificação de inconsistências, riscos e oportunidades relacionadas à precificação. Apoio à liderança em análises para tomada de decisão executiva. O que gostaríamos que você tivesse? Estamos interessados em você como pessoa; sua atitude, comportamentos e valores. Contanto que você tenha a disposição de aprender qualquer coisa que precise para a função que você ainda não tenha, adoraríamos falar com você. Se você tem experiência nas seguintes áreas – esta é uma vantagem adicional: Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Civil e/ou áreas afins. Conhecimento em composição e gestão de preços. Entendimento de impostos indiretos aplicados ao pricing. Conhecimento prático em SAP – módulo SD. Power BI ou Tableau / ferramentas de BI / VBA. Capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e habilidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos. Será um diferencial: Entendimento de impostos indiretos aplicados ao pricing. Experiência com análise de grandes volumes de dados. Nós lhe forneceremos: Vale Refeição + Vale Alimentação. Assistência Médica e Odontológica Bradesco. PLR. Seguro de Vida. Programa Knauf Kare de Qualidade de Vida: Wellhub, Saúde Mental e Nutrição. O que acontece depois? Analisaremos sua candidatura e seu perfil sendo aprovado pela Área de Pessoas e Gestão da área, te convidaremos para um bate-papo. Estamos comprometidos com um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo e, portanto, tomamos todas as decisões de recrutamento em todas as áreas de nossos negócios com base em experiência, habilidades e integridade. Incentivamos candidatos a se candidatarem às nossas vagas, independentemente de idade, gênero, identidade de gênero, condição física, orientação sexual, histórico, religião etc. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: CONSULTOR DE SERVIÇOS FINANCEIROS
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Quando você pensa na Riachuelo, você pensa em nossas lojas, correto? Mas já parou para pensar o que acontece até nossas lojas receberem as coleções que conquistam o Brasil ano após ano? Hoje somos mais de 30 mil criadores de possibilidades espalhados por todo o território nacional, atuando em diversas áreas construindo a Moda que inspira o Brasil. Além das mais de 430 lojas das marcas Riachuelo, Casa Riachuelo, Fan Lab e Carter´s, contamos com times de Corporativo, Fábrica, Centro de distribuições, Contact Center e da nossa financeira, a Midway e muitas outras frentes que atuam juntas em um modelo de negócio integrado que garante que sejamos únicos no mercado brasileiro. Trabalhamos com moda para criar impacto positivo diretamente em nosso país e amamos o que fazemos . A nossa cultura guia nossas ações e nossas relações, reforçando nossa essência brasileira, acolhedora e empreendedora. Lembramos que nossas oportunidades são para todos. Na Riachuelo, você encontra um ambiente diverso, com respeito e empatia, em que cuidamos dos RCHLOVERS. Responsabilidades e atribuições Foco na oferta de produtos e serviços financeiros da empresa, garantindo uma boa experiência ao cliente e contribuindo para os resultados do negócio. Trata‑se de uma função comercial com forte orientação a metas, atendimento e conformidade com normas internas e regulatórias. 1. Atendimento ao cliente Atender clientes de forma consultiva, entendendo necessidades financeiras e perfil de consumo. Orientar sobre produtos financeiros disponíveis, esclarecendo dúvidas com linguagem clara e acessível. Garantir um atendimento ético, transparente e alinhado aos valores da Riachuelo. 2. Oferta e venda de produtos financeiros Divulgar e comercializar produtos financeiros, como: Cartão Riachuelo (private label e bandeirado) Empréstimos pessoais Seguros (ex.: seguro prestamista, proteção financeira) Serviços de parcelamento e renegociação Atuar ativamente na conversão de vendas, respeitando políticas de crédito e elegibilidade. Trabalhar para o atingimento de metas individuais e coletivas de produtos financeiros. 3. Análise e suporte ao crédito Apoiar o cliente no processo de solicitação e utilização do crédito. Conferir documentação e orientar sobre aprovação, limites e condições. Esclarecer regras de pagamento, vencimentos, juros e encargos aplicáveis. 4. Pós-venda e relacionamento Acompanhar clientes após a contratação dos produtos financeiros. Auxiliar em situações como: Dúvidas sobre fatura Renegociação de dívidas Atualização cadastral Contribuir para fidelização e recorrência de uso dos produtos financeiros. 5. Controle de processos e conformidade Cumprir normas internas, políticas de crédito e diretrizes do Banco Central e demais órgãos reguladores. Garantir a correta formalização das propostas e contratos. Zelar pela confidencialidade dos dados dos clientes (LGPD). 6. Apoio à operação da loja Trabalhar de forma integrada com a equipe de vendas da loja. Apoiar campanhas comerciais e ações promocionais ligadas aos produtos financeiros. Contribuir para a organização do espaço de atendimento financeiro. 7. Acompanhamento de indicadores Monitorar desempenho individual por meio de indicadores como: Taxa de conversão Produtos por cliente Qualidade da venda (cancelamentos e inadimplência) Participar de treinamentos, reciclagens e reuniões de alinhamento com a liderança. Requisitos e qualificações Comunicação clara e persuasiva Perfil comercial e foco em resultados Organização e atenção a detalhes Ética e responsabilidade no trato com informações financeiras Capacidade de trabalhar sob metas e pressão saudável por resultados Informações adicionais Assistência médica após 1 ano Assistência odontológica Seguro de vida em grupo Gympass Parcerias educacionais Descontos na Riachuelo Vale Refeição ou Alimentação #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: QA
vagas.description: SOBRE A INEVENT A InEvent é uma startup B2B inovadora e ágil que desenvolve soluções inteligentes para eventose marketing em grandes empresas, criando gerenciamento de alto nível para executivos e ferramentas operacionais robustas para analistas e gerentes. QUEM SOMOS A InEvent é uma empresa de tecnologia de eventos remotos com InEventers em mais de 13 países diferentes, falando mais de 27 idiomas diferentes. Somos uma equipe global. Os InEventers sãouma equipe única, com Visão de crescimento e Valores compartilhados. Nós permitimos que você seja você mesmo e encorajamos a comunicação aberta. O mais importante aqui não é a sua experiência, mas sim a sua curiosidade e paixão por aprender e crescer connosco! QUALITY ANALYST InEvent está procurando por um solucionador de problemas, orientado para detalhes, para Quality Analyst (Analista de Qualidade), que irá desempenhar um papel crítico na otimização do desenvolvimento de nossos produtos. Contamos com você para garantir que estamos fornecendo software e aplicativos com alta qualidade e funcionamento perfeito. RESPONSABILIDADES Desenvolver sistemas de teste para nossa API pública e simular casos de uso para nossas aplicações; Corrigir e resolver problemas e falhas de segurança encontrados nos testes; Analisar os resultados dos testes e informar a equipe de desenvolvimento; Trabalhar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para corrigir bugs e erros; Aprender os modelos de desenvolvimento utilizados em nossas plataformas; Inovar e reestruturar parte de nossos sistemas. PERFIL IDEAL 6 meses de experiência em testes de plataformas web; Formação oucursandoAnálise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas; Bom conhecimento de trabalho em software de gerenciamento de testes, linguagens de programação e metodologias de QA; Boa capacidade de trabalho em equipe e pensamento crítico; Capacidade de aprender e perceber rapidamente a resolução de problemas; Criatividade e curiosidade para aprender e aplicar novos conceitos em nossas plataformas; Gostar de hackathons, ter o espírito de um hacker - quando solicitado, resolver o problema com paixão e vontade. vagas.description: The Production Control Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of production data, acting as the technical authority for hydrocarbon accounting, allocation, reconciliation, and reporting across offshore facilities. Working closely with metering, subsurface, finance, and commercial teams, the role will guarantee reliable calculation and reporting of oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, while driving continuous improvement of accounting systems, data quality, and best practice. Responsibilities Ensure accurate hydrocarbon accounting for oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, including production allocation, reconciliation, inventory management, ullage calculations, and custody transfer, as well as injection, waste, and emissions, performed within internal and industry standards with due diligence, analysis, and data validation. Perform, validate, and approve daily, monthly, and annual production reconciliations between metering systems, tank inventories, export measurements, and allocation calculations prior to regulatory and internal reporting. Support the classification and allocation of production deferment or losses according to internal guidelines. Review, maintain, and improve all hydrocarbon and fluids accounting processes, reporting routines, data acquisition, models, and methodologies, ensuring accurate distribution of production volumes and compliance with internal, industry, and regulatory requirements. Maintain the integrity and reliability of production accounting data, systems, and processes, ensuring full traceability and auditability of all reported figures. Participate in operational reviews and provide production accounting input to support operational decision making. Act as the technical focal point for production control and hydrocarbon accounting matters within the organization. Support regulatory audits, inspections, and data requests related to production and other fluids accounting. Prepare, validate, and submit mandatory monthly and annual production reports to the Brazilian regulatory authority (ANP). Support the implementation and maintenance of production accounting tools and data analytics platforms. Promote automation and digitalization initiatives related to production data management and reporting. Education Bachelor's Degree in any field of Engineering Experience Experience in this position in the Oil and Gas industry. Knowledge Familiar with metering regulation and best industry standards such as ANP, RTM, API, SOX Experience in hydrocarbon accounting and production data management Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, SQL Knowledge in Hydrocarbon Accounting Tools (such as Energy Components, EnergySys, PDM) #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department: Events & Entertainment, Location: Brazil Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The Stadium Entertainment Manager will be responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of all in‑stadium entertainment activations across all assigned venues of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment and supporting the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, this role ensures that all entertainment elements — including pre‑match programming, music, audio‑visual content, half‑time activations, and fan engagement moments — are delivered to the highest standard. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the Stadium Entertainment operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Stadium Entertainment Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days. The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Stadium Entertainment Delivery Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s). Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament. Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content. Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners. Team Support Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities. Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery. Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Technical & Production Coordination Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure. Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues. Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day. Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s). Venue Readiness & Execution Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment. Assist in production processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning. Contribute to readiness activities and provide on‑site support during live operations to ensure delivery standards are met. Support problem solving during matchday entertainment, escalating issues to the Senior Manager as needed. Coordinate rehearsal planning, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder communication in alignment with Senior Manager guidance. Support the validation of entertainment elements during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases. Assist with venue‑level pre‑production tasks, including gathering technical information, supporting infrastructure assessments, and coordinating installation planning. Content Production & Management Coordinate the receipt, testing, and deployment of all entertainment content at venue level, including music, video, graphics, and scripts. Ensure that all content is approved, correctly formatted, and delivered on time in line with operational deadlines. Maintain accurate records of content usage and ensure IP/copyright compliance at venue level. Planning, Scheduling & Documentation Prepare match‑day reports, schedules, show notes and post‑event summaries for the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager. Maintain up‑to‑date operational documentation including rundowns, contact lists, and venue entertainment plans. Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions. Flag operational risks and elevate issues to the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager in a timely manner. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Coordinate with Venue Operations, Broadcast, Protocol, Safety, and other Functional Areas and stakeholders to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations. Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management aligned with project delivery. Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Stadium Entertainment Manager in planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. Support cross‑venue entertainment activities and cover other venues as required during the tournament. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events. Demonstrated experience delivering in‑venue or stadium entertainment programmes, including AV, music and audience engagement activations. Experience working within large‑scale multi‑venue events or major international sporting events is highly desirable. Track record of coordinating multiple suppliers and technical teams in high‑pressure, time‑critical environments. Experience working with broadcast operations and an understanding of live TV production constraints is an advantage. Skills & Competencies Administrative skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments. Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. Communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. Organizational skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. Problem‑solving skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. Cross‑functional collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. Interpersonal skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. Cultural sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. Passion for entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Claroty is a global leader in cyber‑physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast‑growing, award‑winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity. About The Role As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will serve as a strategic technical partner to our enterprise customers, ensuring successful deployment, adoption, and ongoing value realization from Claroty’s platform. You will bridge the gap between customers and internal teams, driving technical alignment, proactive optimization, and long‑term relationship success. This is a high‑impact, customer‑facing role ideal for a strong networking professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, strategy, and customer engagement. Responsibilities Partner with customers to plan, design, deploy, and configure Claroty’s solutions to meet their technical and business objectives while driving measurable value. Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers, owning all technical requirements and ensuring alignment with best practices. Provide ongoing technical guidance, architecture recommendations, and optimization strategies to maximize product adoption and performance. Proactively identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement across customer environments. Translate customer feedback, industry trends, and field insights into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams. Develop technical artifacts, documentation, playbooks, and best practices to streamline deployments and enhance service delivery. Support escalations and complex technical scenarios in partnership with Support and R&D teams. Drive executive‑level technical conversations and present strategic roadmaps aligned with customers’ cybersecurity and operational objectives. Travel up to 30% to support on‑site engagements, workshops, and strategic meetings. Requirements 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Network Engineering, or similar customer‑facing technical roles. Deep knowledge of IT networking; prior experience as a Network Architect is highly beneficial. Strong understanding of networking standards and protocols, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and segmentation principles. Experience with Operational Technology (OT) environments and industrial networks – a strong advantage. Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure network architecture. Network and Cybersecurity Certifications (CCNA, Security+) are a plus. Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) – required. Additional languages, such as Spanish, are a plus. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders. Customer‑centric mindset with the ability to build trusted, long‑term partnerships. Candidates should be comfortable with on‑site work 5 days a week in Rio de Janeiro. Willingness to travel up to 30%. About Claroty Claroty has redefined cyber‑physical systems (CPS) protection with an unrivaled industry‑centric platform built to secure mission‑critical infrastructure. The Claroty Platform provides the deepest asset visibility and the broadest, built‑for‑CPS solution set in the market comprising exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection – whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on‑premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Backed by award‑winning threat research and a breadth of technology alliances, the Claroty Platform enables organizations to effectively reduce CPS risk, with the fastest time‑to‑value and lower total cost of ownership. Our solutions are deployed by over 1,000 organizations at thousands of sites across all seven continents. Claroty is an equal‑opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of all diverse backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Atendimento L1 (remoto e presencial): diagnóstico inicial, execução de runbooks, orientação passo a passo e resolução dentro do escopo L1; quando aplicável, continuidade após camadas automáticas de orientação ( L0,5 ), sem confundir distribuição (L0) com atendimento humano . Descarte e eletrônicos: seguir processos de levantamento, descarte e conformidade quando previstos no hub. vagas.description: Descrição da vaga A Aegea A Aegea foi criada em 2010 e é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local. A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas. Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento. Programa Respeito dá o Tom O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Demonstrar comportamentos de liderança inclusiva que sirvam de exemplo para os funcionários, além de formar, desenvolver e reter equipes diversificadas. Desenvolver outras pessoas com mentoria, coaching e feedback eficaz. Dar apoio e orientar outras pessoas em seus desafios, intervindo quando as conversas ficam difíceis e mantendo a calma em um ambiente de varejo dinâmico e em constante mudança. Gerenciar o trabalho com boa organização, planejamento e priorização. A Apple oferece oportunidades iguais de emprego e está comprometida com a inclusão e a diversidade. Oferecemos adaptações razoáveis para candidatos com deficiência, em conformidade com as leis locais. A Apple é um ambiente de trabalho livre de drogas. Na Apple, acreditamos que a acessibilidade é um direito humano fundamental. Essa ideia está presente em tudo: na nossa cultura, nos nossos benefícios e nas nossas ferramentas digitais. Ao acolhermos as mais variadas perspectivas, ajudamos você a construir uma carreira inclusiva, com a qual se identifica. Principais responsabilidades Atendimento presencial (Tech Stop): fila no balcão, chamadas ordenadas, registro e encerramento adequados no ticket, comunicação clara com o solicitante. Atendimento L1 (remoto e presencial): diagnóstico inicial, execução de runbooks, orientação passo a passo e resolução dentro do escopo L1; quando aplicável, continuidade após camadas automáticas de orientação (L0,5), sem confundir distribuição (L0) com atendimento humano. Workplace e hardware de escritório: notebooks/desktops, periféricos, impressoras e suprimentos no contexto do hub, monitores e cabos, solicitações de equipamento no escopo acordado. Conectividade no workplace: telefonia (chips, ativações, políticas operacionais em coordenação com stakeholders), modem (triagem, troca, tickets). Grab apoio a compras operacionais de suprimentos/gadgets no escopo workplace. Descarte e eletrônicos: seguir processos de levantamento, descarte e conformidade quando previstos no hub. Onboarding no balcão: entrega de kits, orientação inicial e fluxo de Onboarding ligado ao kiosk/painel quando for o caso. Documentação e qualidade: uso de base de conhecimento, comentários no ticket que permitam métricas e auditoria; colaboração com melhoria de scripts, categorias e modelo de atendimento. Escalonamento: casos fora do escopo presencial/L1 imediato ou que exigem profundidade técnica: interface com L2/Eng (Pack 2), mantendo contexto e criticidade corretos no chamado. Indicadores e forma de trabalho (referência interna) Operação orientada a TMA, CSAT e SLAs de primeira resposta/atendimento; volumetria típica com forte componente L1 (remoto/presencial) e parcela de Office Tickets (hardware/ambiente físico), além de atividades de backoffice (estoque, logística, impressoras, telefonia, facilities correlatas, automações operacionais) que não aparecem só como ticket — o papel exige visão de fila + piso. Em hubs com cobertura acima do mínimo, o time pode rotacionar entre foco Tech Stop e foco fila L1 (modelo de dimensionamento/capacidade descrito no repositório). Inglês para leitura e conversação (desejável espanhol em operações multi-país; materiais de kiosk e fluxos costumam ser PT/EN/ES). Familiaridade com ITSM (Jira Service Management ou similar), identidade corporativa (ex.: Okta) e bom registro em chamado. Desejáveis Experiência com workplace: impressão (ex.: PaperCut em contexto hub), telefonia móvel corporativa, inventário/estoque. Conhecimento básico de rede/Wi‑Fi, SO corporativo (macOS conforme padrão da empresa) e troubleshooting de periféricos. Participação prévia em operação multi-hub ou fusos coordenados. O que valorizamos Accountability no ticket (triagem correta, menos reabertura). Colaboração com onboarding, facilities e engenharia na fronteira certa do problema. Nossa missão é contribuir para a formação de crianças criativas, éticas e conscientes de seus deveres por meio da ampliação do repertório cultural e da formação contínua da equipe. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo. Se você se identifica com a nossa proposta, inscreva-se no nosso Banco de Talentos de Professores para Os Batutinhas e assim que surgir uma oportunidade que tenha a ver com o seu perfil, nós entraremos em contato. REQUISITOS O que você precisa ter: Formação adequada para a função que deseja. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais; Inglês intermediário ou avançado. DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Ensuring that the contractor is performing the required contract work in accordance with the design documents. Reviewing engineering shop drawings and determining if the contractor has complied with the final design parameters. Monitoring the construction contractor's quality assurance and safety program. Observing onsite construction and determining if construction elements are being installed, formed, and executed properly. Monitoring construction progress vis‑a‑vis the project schedule and submitting weekly progress reports with recommendations based on the technical review of project documents and field inspections. Performing technical inspections of the mechanical elements of the project. Preparing construction reports detailing construction progress and identifying any problem with the construction process related to the incumbent’s area of expertise. Evaluating the contractor’s proposed remedy after problems are discovered. Formulating solutions for the Project Director/Construction Manager. Reviewing design documents (drawings and specifications) that the A/E prepares as well as performing quality assurance for the construction project in their technical area of expertise. Developing working knowledge of all technical requirements of project. Providing Quality Assurance for ongoing construction project. Reviewing contractor submittals. Preparing responses to Requests for Information (RFI). Evaluating proposed submittal substitutions with engineering implications. Making recommendations to the Project Director. Coordinating the development of Independent Government Estimates (IGEs) for modifications and change orders. Reviewing and evaluating design calculations and data from an engineering perspective. Preparing Monthly Progress Report summarizing project status, with emphasis on engineering. Performing other related duties as assigned by the Project Director. FILLING THIS POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON AWARD Requirements An mechanical engineering degree (Bachelor’s or above) from an accredited program and a minimum of seven (7) years of experience required on construction projects of similar scope and dollar value to the project supported by this Task Order. Design office experience shall not count toward an employee’s experience. A Professional Engineering License (PE) is acceptable in lieu of a degree. Overseas experience is preferred. Must have Final Secret, Interim Top Secret (TS), or Final TS security clearance issued by the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) at the time of consideration. Knowledge of International Codes required. Knowledge of Construction Safety regulations, i.e. EM 385-1-1, OSHA, etc. Knowledge of Microsoft Suite, i.e., PowerPoint, Excel, and Word required. Experience with Building Automation Systems, monitor controls and disconnects, general plumbing, water/sewage treatment, power generation and HVAC systems. Ability to read design/construction drawings and be able to understand design narratives and calculations. Ability to understand and be able to interpret drawings in their discipline and understand the principles of their discipline and how it fits in with other disciplines. Work on the NCC project site construction will be performed to U.S. standards. Current working knowledge of acceptable products and procedures. Ability to review shop drawings and submittals from the contractor and determine if coordination with other disciplines is necessary in addition to monitoring ongoing construction work to identify problems or non-compliance with design or contract specifications. vagas.title: Country Lead, Brazil
vagas.description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. Build the operational foundation for Samba\'s Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba\'s international and executive leadership. Who You Are Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America. Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you\'ve built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background. Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations. Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG. Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD). Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required. vagas.title: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Fan Festival
vagas.description: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Fan Festival Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA27 is the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working with FIFA HQ in Zurich and worldwide to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027). THE POSITION The Event Experiences Marketing Manager supports and implements all strategic deliverables prescribed by the Experiential Marketing Manager in Zurich. Responsibilities include developing, supporting, and delivering innovative and best‑in‑class marketing deliverables and experiential activations. The core deliverable is leading the strategic and commercial development and positioning of the FIFA Fan Festival across Host Cities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, focusing on commercial, promotional, brand, entertainment, partner, and stakeholder integrations. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the manager shapes the narrative, drives partner and government integration, and develops innovative fan engagement in line with FIFA’s strategic objectives from a local perspective. This role works in tandem with the Special Events team at FIFA27, who hold accountabilities for all operational elements of the FFF. However, on a day‑to‑day basis, the Strategy and Operations teams operate and are perceived as one unified team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Support development and implementation of the FIFA Fan Festival commercial and strategic framework. Support communications and promotional planning across Host Cities. Liaise with commercial and media partners to support project alignment and approvals. Prepare workshop planning, presentations and strategic alignment sessions. Maintain SharePoint documentation and ensure excellent project document management. Lead local conversations and meetings, delivering detailed minutes and communications for reporting to Zurich. Support budget tracking, procurement processes and strategic documentation. Support local issue resolution and escalation processes, communicating key decisions, risks and dependencies. Support review of plans and materials to ensure alignment with FIFA commercial rights, partner obligations and clean site principles. Provide local market insights and stakeholder contexts for strategic decision making, planning and delivery. Support Host Cities throughout all strategy and commercial processes. Act as key point of contact for Host Cities and other local stakeholders. Coordinate requests, tracking, review and adaptation of Host City deliverables including promotional copy, brand assets, content inputs and local information. Review and adapt Host City content, copy and materials to ensure consistency with FIFA tone, messaging, objectives and standards. Develop understanding of FWWC27 brand manual and ensure Host City and stakeholder materials reviewed in line with brand requirements. Coordinate feedback, brand approvals and final sign‑off with relevant internal FIFA teams or communicate with FIFA Zurich when necessary. Support local Special Events team to ensure strategic, commercial, promotional and brand requirements understood and integrated into Host City planning and delivery. Support coordination of content capture. Deliver local reporting inputs and post‑event documentation for FIFA27 and Host Cities and stakeholders. Act as project manager for selected experiential marketing projects as required. Coordinate project planning, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder alignment and execution. Support RFP processes, agency evaluation, supplier onboarding and procurement when required. Manage day‑to‑day coordination with agencies and suppliers, ensuring clear briefs, timelines, feedback rounds and delivery expectations. Maintain all project documentation, trackers, meeting notes, action lists and approval records. Ensure projects delivered on time, within scope and in line with FIFA standards and identify, track and communicate key project risks, dependencies, decisions and escalation points. Support post‑project reporting, learnings and evaluation, including documentation of outcomes, performance and recommendations. YOUR PROFILE 4+ years’ experience in marketing, event management or relevant client account management. Proven relevant experience in a similar position or another relevant role. Experience working in a multi‑national, multi‑cultural, and multi‑stakeholder environment. Appreciation and understanding of sport and its role in marketing, fan engagement and popular culture. University degree in a marketing discipline or business administration with relevant major (desired). Proficient in Office 365. Excellent knowledge of MS Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, Monday.com. Flexible, adaptable, proactive, detail‑oriented and constantly striving for excellence. Multi‑tasker with excellent organisational skills and time/priority management. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Stress‑resilient and able to work to immovable deadlines. Excellent stakeholder and network management skills, with understanding of cultural nuances and communication needs for different stakeholders. Comprehensive understanding of entertainment, major events and fan entertainment. Diplomatic and comfortable handling conflicts in a positive and objective manner. Team player and adaptable with strong teamwork ability and willing to go the extra mile. Requirements Fluent in English and Portuguese. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Event Marketing Manager
vagas.description: Event Marketing Manager Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). THE POSITION Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Team Lead, Event Marketing (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Event Marketing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Event Marketing in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for all marketing campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Support the creation and implementation of strategic, high impact, end-to-end marketing campaigns to meet and exceed the objectives of the Tournament In line with the wider FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich teams, define and manage comprehensive GTM multi-channel marketing plans (in close liaison with the digital marketing, ticketing, comms, BI, and brand teams) to support strategic goals to drive awareness, attendance, engagement and retainment Liaise directly with internal and external tournament stakeholders as required including Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners, and Official Media Partners and Licensees to amplify campaigns. Support the development of cross cultural and sector tactical and long-term strategical promotional partnerships with partners and third parties for mutual benefit Create and circulate relevant briefing, publishing plans, planning, valuation, tracking and final reporting documents related to marketing stakeholder’s needs as required Implement influencer strategies in support of marketing objectives. Including mapping of influencers/ambassadors/legends/celebrities and identified events and potentially on-site management/support Ad-hoc support of additional workstreams in relation to event marketing needs which may include contact/planning/liaising with football clubs or participating member associations (PMA’s) Co-Develop launches of major brand assets, such as tournament logos, mascots, posters, and songs, as well as oversee multi-stage global and localised awareness and tournament related sales campaigns Become an expert in FIFA event marketing milestone planning and challenge the status quo and norm with new and creative marketing milestone concepts to ensure amplification and data capture Provide stakeholders with timely and accurate information on promotional and marketing events, activations and opportunities and ensure stakeholders to drive optimisation of the opportunities. YOUR PROFILE Education Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education. Skills & Competencies Adaptable, effective and efficient under pressure, immovable deadlines, and in stressful situations Effective at working proactively and independently whilst providing regular updates, being able to communicate clearly and effectively via different channels with key stakeholders Ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders Willingness to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed Knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture and trends Demonstrates strong attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables Work Experience 5-7 years’ proven experience delivering major brand and marketing plans, and favourable to hold experience with sport's governing bodies, LOCs and, or sports and entertainment rightsholders Deep familiarity and understanding of the dynamics of football Well-connected with existing connections with Key Stakeholders, Partners (Qualified Clubs, Leagues, Associations) Experience in Brand Marketing and Marketing Operations, Communications, Events A passion for football Technology Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools (Monday.com) Requirements Fluent in English and Portuguese Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva? A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades. Responsabilidades e atribuições Estamos em busca de profissionais com deficiência para integrarem o nosso banco de talentos. Esta iniciativa tem como objetivo identificar e conectar talentos que possam contribuir em diversas áreas da empresa, incluindo oportunidades operacionais, administrativas e executivas na plataforma de Trilhos. Ao se cadastrar em nosso banco de talentos, você poderá ser considerado(a) para futuras oportunidades alinhadas ao seu perfil, competências técnicas e habilidades de liderança. Requisitos e qualificações O que esperamos de você: Interesse em desenvolver uma carreira na Motiva; Ter uma deficiência reconhecida, com laudo comprovando a condição; Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e adaptável em diferentes contextos; Competências comportamentais, como boa comunicação, trabalho em equipe, proatividade, organização e senso de responsabilidade. Você se destaca, se tiver: Conhecimentos ou formação técnica nas áreas de manutenção, como mecânica, elétrica, eletrônica, automação, via permanente, rede aérea ou manutenção civil; Conhecimentos ou formação nas áreas administrativas, com domínio do Pacote Office e familiaridade com rotinas administrativas; Conhecimentos ou formação na área de atendimento, com vivência em rotinas operacionais e atendimento ao cliente. Continues building on best practices for improved client satisfaction, while looking for opportunities and submitting ideas to improve team effectiveness and productivity in working with Sales, clients, and Web Service solutions Provides trends and ideas to management and product owners to consider in future products Represents the XML Consultants team in targeted meetings. vagas.title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
vagas.description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Events & Entertainment Location Brazil The Position The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end‑to‑end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision‑making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimise collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), Pre‑Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre‑production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high‑level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organise and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision‑maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue‑level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross‑functional planning forums and senior management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large‑scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team management, creative development, supplier management, and cross‑functional coordination. Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi‑supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Skills & Competencies Administrative Skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments. Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. Organizational Skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. Problem‑Solving Skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. Interpersonal Skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. Cultural Sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. Passion for Entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Desenvolvedor de Software (IA Generativa) | IT Onboarding
vagas.description: Sobre a Área IT Onboarding é a área responsável pela plataforma de onboarding do BTG. A plataforma é elemento central de todas as áreas de negócio do banco e funciona como um hub de informações sobre clientes e contas. Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior qualificado(a) para liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações com Inteligência Artificial Generativa. Esta posição é voltada para quem tem experiência com LLMs (Large Language Models), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Reasoning e Agentic AI e constrói soluções de infraestrutura escaláveis. No Seu Dia a Dia Projetar, construir e escalar aplicações inteligentes usando LangChain, LangGraph e AWS Bedrock, não limitado a estas soluções. Desenvolver APIs robustas e eficientes com Python e FastAPI. Criar protótipos interativos com Streamlit para validação rápida de ideias e apresentações aos stakeholders. Construir fluxos inteligentes com streaming de LLM, integração de ferramentas externas e raciocínio passo a passo. Desenvolver agentes com memória de curto e longo prazo, utilizando estratégias como Hierarchical Task Networks (HTN) e Coordinator-Worker-Delegator (CWD). Integrar sistemas com RabbitMQ e SNS/SQS. Garantir a qualidade de deploy e operação utilizando Kubernetes, incluindo estratégias de rollout, health checks, canary deployments, ingress e services. Monitorar aplicações e fluxos de LLM com ferramentas modernas de observabilidade. Esperamos De Você Graduação completa em Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas. Experiência com desenvolvimento de software com metodologias ágeis. Experiência em design e desenvolvimento de aplicações de grande escala e alto tráfego. Conhecimento prático em soluções AWS, especialmente AWS Bedrock. Boa capacidade de comunicação e proatividade. Diferencial Streaming de LLM e controle de tokens em tempo real. Langfuse: rastreamento, análise e avaliação de interações com LLMs. Datadog: monitoramento de métricas, logs, dashboards e alertas em tempo real. Técnicas como Prompt Caching, Chain of Thought, Tool Calling e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Experiência em tecnologia cloud AWS. Experiência na linguagem de programação C#. Experiência com banco de dados relacional (SQLServer, MySql, PostgreSQL). Boas práticas de programação e Design Patterns. Experiência com testes unitários (TDD). Experiência em mercado financeiro.
