vagas.title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
vagas.description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. Participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned initiatives to drive continuous improvement. Contribute to the growth and capability of junior team members. Qualifications Technical Diploma or Bachelor's degree in relevant fields, such as petroleum technology or mechanical engineering from a recognized and approved program. 10-15 years’ experience in rigless well intervention operations that includes planning and execution of stimulation, wireline, slickline, coiled tubing and flowback operation in critical sour gas and preferably unconventional operational environment. Experience in unconventional resources or HPHT, tight gas & oil well with a very good understanding of well intervention and stimulation operation and its impact on well completion. Proven record in running all types intervention operations required in unconventional wells: Coiled tubing, Wireline, slick line, Hydraulic fracturing, flow back operations. Familiar with wellhead and downhole completion design, optimization, and troubleshooting. Extensive knowledge of industry regulations, safety practices and standards related to surface and downhole equipment selection. Experience in optimization of surface well intervention operation using latest new technologies and best practices. Able to complete an investigation when issues occur and finalize root cause analysis. Experience in performance optimization, cost control, and operational efficiency improvements in unconventional well environments. Strong expertise in unconventional wells operation, well performance analysis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Motion Designer para jogar junto à nossa equipe de Design, presencialmente, no Rio de Janeiro . Na LiveMode, cada movimento é uma jogada para a liderança e inovação no mercado. Como Motion Designer , sua missão será criar artes impactantes e inovadoras, desenvolver peças animadas, tarjas e grafismos de transmissões e garantir a alta qualidade visual de toda a comunicação da LiveMode enquanto atua em parceria com todas as áreas da empresa. Impulsionando não só a nossa presença no mercado, mas a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente. Responsabilidades Criação de peças animadas: Produzir animações, vinhetas, telões Led, tarjas, transições e grafismos para conteúdos; Suporte aos times de Design e Audiovisual: Atuar de forma colaborativa com as equipes, contribuindo com entregas recorrentes, ajustes e desdobramentos visuais; Apoio em artes estáticas: Ajudar na criação de layouts, e adaptações de peças estáticas quando necessário; Pesquisa de tendências e novas ferramentas: Estar sempre atualizado com o que há de novo no universo do design e motion, principalmente em relação a tecnologias emergentes e Inteligência Artificial ; Organização e atenção aos detalhes: Ter uma abordagem metódica nas entregas, garantindo consistência, clareza visual e respeito aos prazos estabelecidos; Design de arenas e competições: Atuar no design e aplicação de materiais visuais em painéis, leds e placas, incluindo envelopamento de estádios. Requisitos necessários Experiência com motion design: portfólio com trabalhos em animação, vinhetas, grafismos ou peças audiovisuais que demonstrem domínio técnico e senso estético; Adaptabilidade e abertura ao novo: capacidade de lidar bem com mudanças rápidas de ferramentas, processos e prioridades — o time vive em constante evolução e espera que a pessoa abrace isso, não resista; Perfil colaborativo e comunicação direta: boa troca com equipes multidisciplinares, disposição para ouvir, compartilhar ideias e se posicionar com clareza; Curiosidade e interesse em IA: vontade genuína de explorar e incorporar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia criativo; Disponibilidade para trabalhar no regime presencial . Diferenciais desejáveis Experiência com Adobe Creative Suite: domínio de Photoshop, Illustrator e After Effects aplicados a projetos de motion e design; Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA generativa: conhecimento em plataformas como Midjourney, Higgsfield e similares voltadas à criação de motions e refinamento de vídeos; Paixão por esportes: interesse genuíno pelo universo esportivo e pelo impacto que ele tem nas pessoas; Inglês intermediário ou acima: capacidade de consumir conteúdo técnico e se comunicar em inglês; Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online; Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT; Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação; Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha; TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira; Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo); Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico; Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade; SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado; Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares. Nossa cultura Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo. SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES Ontem, hoje e sempre Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo. SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE Não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas. SOMOS AMBICIOSOS Pensamos sempre grande A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde. O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia. Pronto pra entrar em campo com a gente? A LiveMode nasceu para atender à crescente demanda digital das entidades esportivas, que agora enfrentam um cenário mais complexo e cheio de oportunidades. Clubes, federações e ligas precisam se adaptar a essa nova realidade com estratégias inovadoras, enquanto marcas buscam formas eficazes de se conectar com o esporte! Aqui, oferecemos parcerias estratégicas para criar e gerenciar modelos de negócios que integram o melhor do digital e da TV, construindo um novo ecossistema que sustentará o esporte nas próximas décadas. Durante nossa trajetória, nosso impacto vai além da simples geração de receita. O mundo digital que desenvolvemos não só conecta o esporte com o público jovem, mas também introduz novos formatos e linguagens, impulsionando um novo ciclo de crescimento para diversas modalidades. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Consultor de Negócios (Ekotruck)
vagas.description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR) . No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Expandir o segmento B2C premium — atualmente 15% do faturamento, com grande potencial de crescimento junto a executivos e profissionais de alta renda. Prospectar novas parcerias corporativas (B2B) e canais para clientes premium individuais (B2C triple A), ampliando receita em ambos os segmentos. Negociar contratos com cláusulas de equilíbrio econômico, incluindo incentivos e penalidades por não ativação de vidas. Colaborar com a agência de marketing parceira no desenvolvimento de campanhas de ativação e prospecção. Fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes existentes, garantindo retenção, NPS elevado e oportunidades de upsell. vagas.description: About the Company RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. RX empowers businesses to thrive by leveraging data‑driven insights and digital solutions. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information‑based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit About the Job The UX Designer is responsible for owning and evolving the end‑to‑end user journey across products, features, and touchpoints. This role defines how users experience our solutions from discovery to adoption, ensuring consistency, usability, and business impact. Works closely with Product, Technology, Research, and Business stakeholders to translate user needs and business goals into scalable, data‑driven experience solutions. This role has clear ownership over user experience outcomes, not just individual screens or features. Operates with a high degree of autonomy, while maintaining strong alignment with cross‑functional partners. Responsibilities End‑to‑End User Journey Ownership Owns, maintains, and evolves end‑to‑end user journey maps, ensuring a holistic view across products, channels, and touchpoints. Identifies friction points, gaps, and opportunities throughout the entire customer lifecycle. Ensures consistency and coherence of the user experience across initiatives and teams. Acts as a UX point of reference for journey‑level decisions, balancing user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints. Customer & User Focus Works collaboratively with UX team to continuously understand customer behaviors, needs, motivations, and pain points across the journey. Translates qualitative and quantitative insights into clear experience opportunities. Understands and anticipates how design decisions impact customer satisfaction, engagement, and retention. Monitors market trends, competitive movements, and industry best practices to inform journey improvements. Experience Strategy & Creative Problem Solving Contributes actively to experience strategy for a product line or business area. Partners proactively with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business stakeholders to ideate and shape experience‑led solutions. Uses structured problem‑solving and creative thinking to address complex, ambiguous challenges. Advocates for user‑centered decision‑making throughout the product lifecycle. Identifies opportunities to improve existing journeys and proposes future‑state experience visions. Product & Interaction Design Defines UX concepts, interactions, and flows using tools such as journey maps, service blueprints, wireframes, prototypes, and process flow diagrams. Designs experiences that scale across platforms (web, mobile, etc.) and use cases. Ensures solutions align with design systems, accessibility standards, and established UX principles. Introduces and helps evolve design patterns, guidelines, and standards with a journey‑level perspective. Clearly articulates design rationale, trade‑offs, and recommendations to diverse stakeholders. Data‑Driven Analysis & Testing Defines and tracks user experience success metrics (e.g., task success, usability metrics, journey KPIs). Leverages analytics, research findings, and business data to validate assumptions and inform design decisions. Identifies data gaps and partners with Research and Analytics to close them. Plans, executes, and iterates usability and concept testing across different stages of the journey. Continuously refines solutions based on insights and evidence. Collaboration, Influence & Governance Acts as a bridge between teams impacting the same user journey, helping align efforts and remove experience inconsistencies. Facilitates collaborative workshops (e.g., journey mapping, ideation, alignment sessions). Influences roadmap and prioritization discussions by advocating for experience improvements. Builds trusted relationships with cross‑functional partners and promotes shared ownership of user outcomes. Technical & Design Skills Demonstrates strong understanding of the organization’s technology stack and its impact on user experience. Designs effectively for multiple platforms and understands interaction constraints. Uses design and prototyping tools at an intermediate to advanced level. Communicates designs clearly through documentation, prototypes, and presentations. Requirements Personal Capability & Growth Actively seeks and applies feedback to improve performance. Continuously develops UX, product, and business skills. Demonstrates self‑awareness of strengths and development areas. Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking Breaks down complex, ambiguous problems into actionable insights. Synthesizes inputs from multiple sources to propose thoughtful solutions. Manages day‑to‑day challenges independently with sound judgment. Innovation & Continuous Improvement Experiments with new methods, tools, and approaches to improve outcomes. Contributes ideas to enhance existing processes and UX practices. Brings curiosity and openness to change. Communication & Collaboration Communicates clearly, confidently, and persuasively. Practices active listening and constructive dialogue. Shares knowledge and contributes to team learning. Experience & Education Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Marketing, or related field. Language Requirement: Fluent English is required. Minimum Experience: 4–6 years in UX Design, Product Design, or related roles. Proven experience working across multiple phases of the product lifecycle. Demonstrated ability to influence experience decisions beyond individual features. A portfolio demonstrating end‑to‑end user journey thinking is required. Critical Experiences Proven experience owning or co‑owning end‑to‑end user journeys, from problem discovery through solution validation and iteration. Experience working across multiple products, platforms, or channels, ensuring consistency in user experience. Demonstrated ability to influence product or experience decisions through insights, data, and design rationale. Hands‑on experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, Research, and Business stakeholders in agile or hybrid environments. Experience facilitating or contributing to journey‑level activities such as journey mapping, service blueprinting, or cross‑team alignment workshops. Track record of iterating solutions based on user research, usability testing, and quantitative data. We know your well‑being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. OESD provides specialized and timely operations and process engineering support to all process technologies operated in both wholly‑owned and affiliates' refining and chemicals operating facilities, collectively known as Saudi Aramco Global Manufacturing. You will use your expertise to drive performance enhancements by identifying and closing gaps discovered through the benchmarking process. Personally, conduct on‑site data collection, verification, and quality review during Solomon benchmarking in Global Manufacturing Affiliates' facilities. Develop comprehensive reports documenting findings and actionable recommendations for presentation to Global Manufacturing management and affiliates. Lead the planning, development, and execution of solutions to bridge identified performance gaps, demonstrating measurable improvements. Formulate and implement expense/margin optimization plans to maximize financial performance of Global Manufacturing Affiliates' facilities. Work directly with affiliates' facilities to establish performance targets and measure progress using Solomon metrics. Assess and quantify the future impact of planned capital improvements and modifications on Solomon benchmarking metrics. Develop and present regular performance benchmarking reports capturing the Solomon metrics for all Global Manufacturing affiliates' facilities. Mentor junior team members in Solomon benchmarking methodologies and best practices. You must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. You will have demonstrated ability to apply Solomon benchmarking methodologies to drive tangible improvements in plant performance. In‑depth working knowledge of refinery industry process plant characteristics and operations is essential. Proven ability to facilitate technical discussions and influence various stakeholders, including senior management. Advanced proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Solomon benchmarking (please specify tools in your application). vagas.title: Sales Manager, CMS -Sao Paulo
vagas.description: Why Join Us? Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimizing renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centers, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. For a second year running, Vaisala got recognized in TIME Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth 2026 study. Our team of close to 2,500 experts and 62 nationalities around the world is committed to taking every measure for the planet. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong. Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil What’s your role? The Sales Manager, Continuous Monitoring Systems (Life Sciences), will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding market share in Brazil. This role involves new business development, managing relationships with existing key accounts, developing distributor’s sales and technical capabilities, developing strategic sales plans, and ensuring customer satisfaction with Vaisala’s solutions. Business Development: Proactively identify, target and acquire new customers within the Life Sciences industry, while reporting the progress in our CRM tool. Sales Strategy Development: Enhance and execute the sales strategy to achieve sales targets and expand Vaisala’s presence in the Life Sciences market within the region. Market Analysis: Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities and stay informed about industry trends and competitor activities. Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers in the Life Sciences sector. Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing insights and solutions that meet their needs. Sales Excellence: Oversee the entire sales process from lead qualification to closing deals, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Utilize Salesforce to track sales activities and customer interactions. Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (locally and internationally), including internal sales, product management, marketing, field service and customer service, to align sales efforts with company objectives and ensure customer satisfaction. Product Expertise: Maintain in-depth knowledge of Vaisala’s Continuous Monitoring solution and services, effectively communicating their value to customers. What will you bring? Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronic or automation engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years of sales experience in the life sciences industry, or selling monitoring systems. Proven track record of developing new business, achieving sales targets and growing market share. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Value selling is key to succeed in this role. Ability to travel up to 50% of the time within the region. Experience and discipline using CRM tools such as Salesforce. Fluent Portuguese and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory for this role. Spanish skills are considered a big plus. Key Differentiators Previous participation and networking with key associations like ISPE and PDA in the region. Understanding of Computerized System Validation and other regulatory concepts. Solid technical background in instrumentation, automation and systems sales. Ability to communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams (IT, Quality Control, Engineering, Maintenance). What we offer Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the market. Hybrid work model, combining office and home office. Flexible meal vouchers (Flash), compatible with regional standards. Full health and dental coverage (no coparticipation). Life insurance. An international, collaborative, and positive work environment, with opportunities to interact with global teams and develop your career in a high-technology company. Ready to take every measure for the planet? Apply at the latest on June 30th, 2026 via the application form. vagas.title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação! Ao assumir o cargo de Cientista de Dados Sênior na Afya, seu principal objetivo será desenvolver soluções avançadas de ciência de dados e inteligência artificial, gerando impacto estratégico para produtos, operação e tomada de decisão da companhia . Você atuará na área de Data & AI , dentro da diretoria de Tecnologia & Produto , e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas dos times de Produto, Engenharia e Analytics . Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS. Responsabilidades e atribuições COMO VOCÊ VAI TRANSFORMAR A SAÚDE NO DIA A DIA: Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e soluções de machine learning aplicados a desafios de negócio e produto; Construir e evoluir soluções de IA Generativa com foco em LLMs e SLMs; Conduzir análises estatísticas avançadas, testes A/B e estudos de inferência causal; Projetar pipelines e arquiteturas de ciência de dados escaláveis e resilientes; Garantir boas práticas de MLOps e LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, observabilidade e governança de modelos; Atuar no ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de modelos, desde discovery até produção e acompanhamento de performance; Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto para transformar modelos em soluções aplicáveis e escaláveis; Estruturar processos de avaliação e experimentação para evolução contínua dos modelos; Contribuir para disseminação de boas práticas e evolução técnica do time; Acompanhar tendências, pesquisas e avanços em inteligência artificial e ciência de dados. Requisitos e qualificações O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos): Pós-graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas; Experiência avançada e comprovada em Python , utilizando bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch; Conhecimento sólido em estatística, inferência causal e design de experimentos , incluindo testes A/B; Experiência com técnicas de Machine Learning , como classificação, regressão, clusterização e séries temporais; Conhecimento em Deep Learning e modelos avançados de IA; Experiência prática no desenvolvimento e produção de soluções com IA Generativa , especialmente LLMs e SLMs; Domínio do ciclo de vida de Data Science (MLOps/LLMOps) , incluindo arquitetura, evaluation, monitoramento e observabilidade; Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento e orquestração de modelos , como MLflow; Inglês avançado , especialmente para leitura de artigos científicos e comunicação técnica; Diferencial: Experiência com Databricks; Experiência com processamento distribuído utilizando Spark. Informações adicionais BENEFÍCIOS: GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE , por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time. vagas.title: Sales Manager - South & Central America
vagas.description: Sales Manager - South & Central America Drive regional sales growth by building strategic partnerships and technical customer engagement Location: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil About The Role Teledyne Marine Sales Manager Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins. Teledyne Marine is a group of leading-edge undersea technology companies that have been assembled by Teledyne Technologies Incorporated. Through acquisitions and collaboration, over the past 10 years Teledyne Marine has evolved into an industry powerhouse, bringing the best of the best together under a single umbrella. With technologies divided into five core segments; Imaging, Instruments, Interconnect, Seismic and Vehicles, Teledyne Marine sales staff can address not only brand level solutions, but turn-key, customized systems that leverage our full range of technology. Our goal is to provide one-stop purchasing capability, world-wide customer support, and the technical expertise to solve our customer's toughest challenges. A Sea of Solutions…..One Supplier. JOB SUMMARY The Sales Manager is responsible for Sales of Teledyne Marine products in the defined area both directly and through distributors, specific responsibility to support the Central & South America's for Teledyne Marine's Imaging & Instruments and Vehicles verticals. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsibility to build and maintain an active pipeline in a CRM, Salesforce, to exceed orders and sales targets on a quarterly, and annual basis. Provide accurate booking forecasts and keep up-to-date customer and pipeline records. Actively manage the channels to ensure they are fully engaged, optimized, and driven to succeed. Develop and drive a regional sales strategy to maximize market penetration of Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles products including new market entries both direct and with channel partners. Orchestrate and hold technical seminars, product presentations and customer demonstrations direct and in conjunction with partners and channels. Remain informed of competitor status, products, advantages, and weaknesses. Develop and maintain a solid understanding of market conditions and trends. Identify opportunities and capture market share growth while collaborating with the Teledyne Marine businesses to optimize efforts. Be responsible for discovering Teledyne Marine non-standard sales opportunities and participate in the selling process in collaboration with product management. Understand fully the benefits and functionality of each of the products in Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles portfolio and how they compare within the market. EDUCATION Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent experience Relevant background/education in a maritime organization would be advantageous, specifically hydrography. SKILLS Strong interpersonal acumen, communicate effectively from entry level to C-suite customers. Languages needed – English, Spanish, Portuguese, all at working level. Excellent communication ability with all nationalities, written as well as verbal. Ability to have or attain good comprehension of technical/maritime issues. AUTHORITIES Providing quotations to Agents/Reps within pricing authority Providing quotations to customers within pricing authority Recommend termination and hiring of Agents/Reps within the region based on defined performance criteria METRICS Booking Target Revenue Target Quarterly reports on Agents / Reps Ability to provide timely and accurate booking prognosis. Ability to provide qualitative feedback on market conditions and trends, new customer applications and product ideas Ability to report competitive activity Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: O MIND é o braço de inovação da Multiplan. Atuamos hoje com um portfólio de 20 dos melhores empreendimento do Brasil, além de diversos outros projetos em desenvolvimento. Com 51 anos de mercado, iniciamos em 2017 uma importante jornada de transformação digital e contamos com você para continuar impulsionando essa missão. Nosso trabalho envolve Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, prospecção de novas tecnologias e a transformação de ideias em negócios, explorando temas como digital, inteligência artificial, big data, robótica e otimização de processos. E, por fim, mas igualmente essencial, valorizamos profissionais que saibam trabalhar bem em equipe. Estamos em busca de um Analista de Governança e Processos de TI com perfil analítico e focado em conformidade. O objetivo deste profissional será estruturar e monitorar as políticas de TI, garantindo que a administração de sistemas, o controle de acessos e o inventário de ativos sigam os padrões de segurança e eficiência operacional. Este profissional, além de ser um arquiteto dos fluxos e o auditor das normas, terá o papel de executor técnico das pontas em alguns casos, servindo como ponte entre a estratégia da gerência e a operação técnica. Principais Responsabilidades: Gestão de Políticas e Normas: Elaborar, revisar e aplicar políticas de segurança da informação, uso de ativos e conformidade (TI General Controls). Desenho de Processos (ITSM): Mapear e otimizar processos críticos como Onboarding/Offboarding de colaboradores, gestão de mudanças e gestão de incidentes. Controle de Acessos (IAM): Definir a matriz de perfis de acesso e realizar revisões periódicas (auditorias) para garantir o princípio do privilégio mínimo. Gestão de Ativos (ITAM): Garantir a integridade do inventário de hardware e software, monitorando o ciclo de vida dos ativos e a conformidade de licenciamento (Compliance). Administração de Endpoints (Governança): Definir os padrões de configuração e segurança que devem ser aplicados aos dispositivos da empresa via ferramentas de MDM. Gestão de Indicadores (KPIs): Criar e monitorar dashboards de desempenho da TI, níveis de serviço (SLA) e aderência aos processos. Auditoria e Conformidade: Atuar como ponto focal em auditorias internas e externas, garantindo que as evidências de controle estejam sempre organizadas. Requisitos Técnicos: Experiência em Governança de TI, Gestão de Serviços ou Compliance. Experiência em frameworks de mercado como ITIL. Conhecimento em metodologias de mapeamento de processos (BPMN). Familiaridade com conceitos de Segurança da Informação (ISO 27001) e LGPD. Visão técnica sobre administração de diretórios e ferramentas de inventário. Soft Skills (Habilidades Comportamentais): Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de entender como uma pequena mudança em um processo afeta toda a organização. Organização: Necessária para lidar com documentações, prazos de auditoria e inventários complexos. Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade para negociar a aplicação de políticas com diferentes áreas da empresa. Perfil Ético e Imparcial: Fundamental para realizar auditorias e garantir o cumprimento das regras. Benefícios: Plano Bradesco Top Nacional (com co-participação) Odontológico Bradesco (opcional) Vale Refeição Gympass Trabalho remoto com idas esporádicas ao escritório Incentivo a cursos e palestras pelo Brasil Vaga para carro PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados de acordo com a política em vigo do ano #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: BRAMU Medical Support Officer
vagas.description: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international medical humanitarian organization that provides neutral, impartial, and independent healthcare to people affected by conflict, epidemics, natural disasters, or exclusion from access to healthcare in more than 70 countries. Aligned with the values that guide the actions of our organization around the world, MSF-Brazil is committed to promoting inclusion and diversity and understands the importance of affirmative action aimed at promoting equal opportunities. For this reason, seeking to provide ethnic‑racial equity, only applications from people who self‑declare black (brown or black) and who meet the established requirements will be accepted. BRAMU – Brazilian Medical Unit BRAMU is a medical unit that responds to the different MSF projects in the Latin American region through technical advice and strategic‑operational support. BRAMU professionals provide technical support as requested by the Operational Centers based on project needs. The main activities constitute the following: Technical and Operational Support to project teams, Provision of training, Development of institutional partnerships, and advocacy in the medical area. The growing challenges in the Latin American region around migration, violence, environmental crisis and other emerging health issues have made the unit move towards a comprehensive, interdisciplinary approach using applied social sciences, evidence‑based medicine, and epidemiology. BRAMU’s portfolio of services is targeted to the following topics: Migration, Urban violence, Environmental health, Adolescent Health, and Mental Health. The team comprises six experts: a Migration & Violence advisor, an Environmental Health advisor, an Adolescent Health advisor, an epidemiologist, a Health Promotion focal point, and a Psychosocial support focal point. OBJECTIVE To strengthen and develop the institutional medical work of MSF Brazil to enrich the connection of the Latin American reality with MSF operations worldwide through institutional representation and by connecting MSF with experts and innovative actors in the region. In addition, it offers transversal medical support to BRAMU activities in all the portfolio thematics. RESPONSIBILITIES MSF-Brazil institutional medical support: Contribute to enlarging and maintaining a regional institutional medical network and initiatives by participating in strategic meetings/conferences/events/workshops. Support Fundraising and Communications departments in activities requiring medical advice, such as information and communication strategies on medical topics. Validate medical content for articles, interviews, magazines, donor consultations on medical issues, etc. Support the Management Team of MSF-Brazil, in medical positions, reflections, and institutional representation when necessary. Lead the medical component of advocacy initiatives/activities. Work with the HR department and staff health focal point to develop and adapt staff health protocols, if needed. Participates in relevant national forums to disseminate/represent BRAMU/MSF-Brazil’s position on humanitarian medical issues. Contribute to reflection on medical and humanitarian dilemmas in the region through debates, analysis, and brainstorming exercises within MSF and with external partners. Act as point of contact for MSF-Brazil institutional issues in the absence of the BRAMU director. Collaborate with the MSF- Brazil association to develop a medical network, participating as a medical representative in the different association initiatives when relevant. vagas.title: ANALISTA DE PROJETOS DE ENGENHARIA - RIO DE JANEIRO/RJ
vagas.description: A SANDECH foi fundada em 2008, no Rio de Janeiro, com foco na elaboração de projetos multidisciplinares para o setor industrial. Ao longo da nossa trajetória, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, atendendo grandes players como Petrobras, Braskem, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau, em segmentos como óleo e gás, químico e petroquímico, farmacêutico, alimentício, siderúrgico e infraestrutura. Atuamos com tecnologias avançadas, como laser scan, drones e integração ao modelo BIM, sempre buscando soluções mais eficientes, seguras e inovadoras para nossos clientes. Contamos com um Sistema de Gestão Integrado (SGI) robusto, certificado internacionalmente nas normas ISO 9001:2015 (Qualidade), ISO 14001:2015 (Gestão Ambiental) e ISO 45001:2018 (Saúde e Segurança Ocupacional), refletindo nosso compromisso com excelência operacional, sustentabilidade e segurança. Nosso sistema é amplamente reconhecido e já foi aprovado em auditorias conduzidas por diversos clientes, garantindo a execução de projetos críticos com alto padrão de qualidade e confiabilidade. Mais do que entregar projetos, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com excelência, inovação e evolução contínua. RESPONSABILIDADES: Realizar análise técnica de documentação de engenharia para entendimento do funcionamento de equipamentos e processos industriais; Interpretar documentos técnicos como P&IDs, PFDs, datasheets, manuais de operação e manutenção, listas de instrumentos e variáveis; Executar levantamento técnico de instrumentos, sensores e equipamentos industriais a partir de documentação disponível; Identificar e organizar dados técnicos relevantes para cadastro de equipamentos (tagueamento, características operacionais, parâmetros de processo); Identificar variáveis críticas de monitoramento da condição de equipamentos, correlacionando dados operacionais com desempenho e possíveis desvios; Atuar no cadastro estruturado de ativos/equipamentos em sistemas ou bases de dados, garantindo padronização e qualidade das informações; Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, operação, manutenção), garantindo alinhamento técnico das informações levantadas; Consolidar e organizar informações técnicas de diferentes fontes, assegurando rastreabilidade e consistência dos dados; Apoiar na melhoria contínua da qualidade dos dados e processos relacionados ao cadastro e gestão de ativos. REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS: Formaçpão em Engenharia (Química, Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção ou correlatas); Experiência prévia em análise técnica de equipamentos industriais ou projetos de engenharia; Experiência com leitura e interpretação de documentação técnica (P&ID, PFD, datasheets, manuais); Vivência com levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos e instrumentos industriais; Conhecimento de variáveis de processo (pressão, temperatura, vazão, vibração, corrente elétrica, rotação); Conhecimento em AutoCAD; Conhecimento em Pacote Office; Conhecimento em Sistemas de cadastro/gestão de ativos ou bases de dados (ERP, EAM ou similares); Experiência com cadastro técnico de ativos/equipamentos em sistemas ou bases de dados; Inglês técnico para leitura e interpretação de documentação. REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS: Experiência em projetos de monitoramento de condição ou manutenção preditiva; Vivência em ambiente industrial (óleo & gás, siderurgia, mineração, energia ou manufatura); Experiência com sistemas de gestão de ativos (EAM/CMMS); Conhecimento em SAP PM ou outros sistemas de gestão de manutenção; Conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas de análise de dados; Conhecimento em instrumentação industrial e automação; Familiaridade com conceitos de confiabilidade e desempenho de ativos; Experiência com análise de falhas ou diagnóstico de equipamentos. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista Operações Logísticas, AMXL
vagas.description: Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejan itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logística do Brasil está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time que gerencia as operações de Extra Large (AMXL). Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back. Essa pessoa atuará na gestão e execução tática das rotinas nas estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco para atuar como guardião dos SOPs padrões do node. Key job responsibilities Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias; Orientar e liderar plano de ação com parceiros em busca da excelência operacional; Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos; Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas; Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos; Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações; Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais. A day in the life Seu dia é dedicado a monitorar a Torre de Controle e executar rotinas diárias no node para entregas de produtos Pesados/Grandes (Heavy/Bulky). Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. Você coordena com a equipe para resolver desafios operacionais para encantar o cliente Amazon. Seu principal contato é o parceiro AMXL, cuja performance você melhora diretamente através de planos de ações consolidados. Requirements Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas. MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros). Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados. Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo. Inglês básico. Inglês avançado. SQL e outras linguagens de programação. Experiência em Logística, e/ou Transportes de itens volumosos e pesados. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista de Projeto de Produto Pleno
vagas.description: A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona. Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente. Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo. Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Projeto de Produto Pleno (Product Owner) e a missão desse cargo será garantir que todos os lançamentos de produto avancem com clareza, ritmo e qualidade do início ao fim. vagas.description: Description FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Department: Commercial & Marketing Location: Brazil Description FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). THE POSITION The Event Experiences Marketing Manager (FFF) supports and implements all strategic deliverables prescribed by the Experiential Marketing Manager (FFF) based in Zurich. This includes developing, supporting, and delivering innovative and best-in-class FFF deliverables and other experiential marketing activations that might be developed. The core deliverable is to lead the strategic and commercial development and positioning of the FIFA Fan Festival™ across Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, focusing on the commercial, promotional, brand, entertainment, and partner and stakeholder integrations. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the manager will help shape the narrative, drive partner and government integration, and develop innovative fan engagement in line with FIFA’s strategic objectives from a local perspective. This role and team will work in tandem with the Special Events team at FIFA27, who hold accountabilities for all operational elements of the FFF. However, on a day‑to‑day basis, the Strategy and Operations teams will operate and be perceived as one unified team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES FIFA Fan Festival™ FWWC2027 - Commercial & Strategy Support the development and implementation of the FIFA Fan Festival™ commercial and strategic framework. Support communications and promotional planning across Host Cities. Liaise with commercial and media partners (alongside the local Commercial and Media partnership teams) to support project alignment and approvals. Prepare workshop planning, presentations, and strategic alignment sessions. Maintain all SharePoint documentation and ensure excellent level of project document management Lead on local conversations and meetings while delivering detailed meetings and project updates including meeting minutes and communications for reporting back to the team in Zurich. Support budget tracking, procurement processes, and relevant strategic documentation. Support local issue resolution and escalation processes, ensuring key decisions, risks and dependencies are clearly communicated to the Zurich team. Support the review of plans and materials to ensure alignment with FIFA commercial rights, partner obligations, and clean site principles. Provide local market insights and stakeholder contexts to support strategic decision making, planning, and delivery when needed. FIFA Fan Festival™ FWWC2027 - Host City Coordination Support Host Cities throughout all strategy and commercial processes. Act as a key point of contact for Host Cities at local level and any other local stakeholders. Coordinate requests, tracking, review and adaptation of Host City deliverables, including promotional copy, brand assets, content inputs and local information. Review and adapt Host City content, copy and materials to ensure consistency with FIFA tone, messaging, objectives and standards. Develop a strong understanding of the FWWC27 brand manual and ensure Host City and stakeholder materials are reviewed in line with FIFA brand requirements. Coordinate feedback, brand approvals, and final sign-off with relevant internal FIFA teams. Or communicate with FIFA Zurich where necessary. Support the local Special Events team to ensure FIFA Fan Festival™ strategic, commercial, promotional and brand requirements are understood and integrated into Host City planning and delivery. Support the coordination of content capture Delivery of local reporting inputs and post event documentation for FIFA27 and Host Cities and relevant stakeholders. Experiential Projects Act as project manager for selected experiential marketing projects as required. Coordinate project planning, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, and execution. Support RFP processes, agency evaluation, supplier onboarding, and procurement processes when required. Manage day-to-day coordination with agencies and suppliers, ensuring clear briefs, timelines, feedback rounds, and delivery expectations. Maintain all project documentation, trackers, meeting notes, action lists, and approval records. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and in line with FIFA standards and identify, track and communicate key project risks, dependencies, decisions and escalation points. Support post-project reporting, learnings and evaluation, including documentation of outcomes, performance and recommendations. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves Minimum 5 years of B2B sales experience managing a mix of Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Deep knowledge of the Rio de Janeiro corporate landscape and an active local network among finance leaders, CFOs, and key corporate decision-makers. Working proficiency in English and fluent Portuguese, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows and optimize daily outreach. Adaptability to fast-changing environments, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate independently. Nice to haves Experience selling complex SaaS, financial technology, ERP systems, or corporate card solutions. Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL , or Python to dive into pipeline metrics and market data. Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn it. A good sense of humor. Why join Clara At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America. Who we are We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup . Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. vagas.title: Brand Ambassador / Activation Manager, L43 - Rio, Brazil
vagas.description: The Activation Manager role represents a strategic transformation in how Zamora Company approaches the market. Moving beyond traditional brand advocacy, this position serves as a strategic partner to both On-Trade and Off-Trade channels, with a clear focus on driving sell-out, ensuring flawless execution of our brands across all touchpoints, and delivering measurable return on investment in the Rio region. With a strong entrepreneurial mindset, this individual will spend the majority of their time in-market, working hands‑on to elevate execution. They will lead the adoption of the AVQPAP model (Availability, Visibility, Quality, Price, Activation, Promotion) to bring the Picture of Success to life. Partnering closely with distributor sales teams and key customers, they will identify opportunities, close executional gaps, and build long‑term, value‑driven relationships across São Paulo and the broader Southeast region. This role is critical to advancing Zamora's ambition of building a best‑in‑class route-to-market and execution model in Brazil. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Field Execution & Market Presence Be present in the market on a daily basis, visiting On Trade, Off Trade and Key Accounts, ensuring the correct execution of Zamora’s brands. Accompany the distributor's team in top accounts to guarantee strategic alignment. Monitor and master the AVQPAP execution standards (Availability, Visibility, Quality of Display, Price, Activation, Promotion) across the territory. Identify execution gaps and immediately work with distributors and outlets to correct them. Ensure all points of sale are aligned with Zamora’s brand positioning and premium image. Distributor & Sales Team Development Work hand in hand with distributor sales teams, acting as a field coach and execution driver to generate sell out. Support sales reps during visits, helping them to sell, place, activate and upgrade Zamora brands. Train distributor and customers’ sales forces on ZC Brands (brand building and story‑selling) Trade Marketing & Activation Design and execute point‑of‑sale activation plans tailored to Rio’s On & Off Trade reality. Implement national and regional brand programs in the field, ensuring perfect execution at store level. Lead tastings, bartender activations, menu placements, cocktail programs and in‑store promotions. Be responsible for the quality of execution of key platforms like L43 Puro, Carajillo and Limão. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Detection Act as Zamora’s market radar in Rio. Identify trends, new hot spots, key bartenders, emerging venues and new retail opportunities. Monitor competitors’ activities, pricing, promotions and visibility. Provide regular feedback to the Area Director and Marketing Team with actionable insights. Relationship Building Build strong and trusted relationships with: Distributor management and sales teams Bartenders, bar managers, store owners and buyers Key influencers Become a recognized Zamora representative in the Rio trade. Develop mid- and long‑term partnerships that secure Zamora’s presence in priority accounts. Reporting & Performance Tracking KPIs will be measured in 4 pillars: Business (eg. volume sold on On trade Channel) Commercial Execution (# stores with perfect execution) Promotion (eg, number of trainings) Digital (Eg. reports/ community built) Provide structured reports with photos, insights and recommendations. Help to ensure activities and investments are properly documented and evaluated. REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Brand Activation, Sales or Brand Ambassador roles, ideally in the alcoholic beverages industry. Having worked with distributors is a plus Deep understanding of On-Trade and Off-Trade dynamics in Rio, with a strong “in‑market” mindset and passion for being close to the consumer (bars, restaurants, clubs, and retail). Good understanding of On Trade & Off Trade dynamics in Rio. Strong ability to execute and drive others to execute. Proven ability to execute with excellence and influence others to deliver against high standards in the field. Strong relationship‑building skills, with the ability to engage and partner effectively with distributor sales teams, bartenders, and retail customers. Analytical and action‑oriented mindset, capable of translating field insights into clear, impactful actions. Highly organized, disciplined, and results‑driven, with strong attention to execution quality. Naturally curious and connected to cultural trends (music, nightlife, gastronomy, fashion), with the ability to anticipate emerging opportunities in the market. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus. Willingness to travel extensively within São Paulo state and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends. This role is a key pillar in Zamora’s ambition to build a best‑in‑class execution model in Brazil—ensuring our brands are visible, desired, and flawlessly brought to life at every relevant point of sale in Rio. Zamora Company is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Esqueça os silos tradicionais, a lentidão de aprovações e os relatórios mensais 'para leigos'. Estamos construindo um centro de comando em tempo real. Para que esse ecossistema funcione na velocidade que o mercado exige, nossa atuação é 100% presencial no Rio de Janeiro. Afinal, a tomada de decisão acontece aqui, 'na mesma mesa', no calor dos dados. Como Especialista, você será o cientista de dados focado em mídias digitais. Auditoria e Resolução de Gargalos: Garantir a confiabilidade absoluta dos dados que a agência apresenta versus o que realmente entra no Salesforce, identificando com precisão a origem e a qualidade dos leads. Experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including at senior level. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to navigate discussions, resolve issues and drive decisions in a constructive and controlled manner. High level of adaptability and resilience, with the ability to respond to changing priorities, evolving plans and a dynamic operating environment. Comfortable working across time zones and flexible working hours, with willingness to travel extensively as required. Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. vagas.title: Subsea Lead / Well Control Equipment Lead
vagas.description: Job Overview Under the direction of the WCE manager, this position provides support across the division with the goal of maintaining healthy, reliable BOPs, minimizing WCE downtime, and eliminating unplanned BOP pulls. The employee ensures proactive planning and execution of all BOP maintenance activities and provides onboard QA/QC support during IBWM execution periods, planned out-of-service periods, and in‑field WCE projects. Key duties include managing the WCE support team, handling technical support for downtime events, engaging customers, OEMs, and regulators, completing offshore subsea assessments, and coaching the offshore subsea community. Key Roles and Responsibilities Provides technical support for WCE downtime events and escalates issues to the WCE manager. Engages customers, OEMs, and regulators in support of operations. Completes offshore subsea assessments as directed. Provides coaching and mentoring of the offshore subsea community. Assists in WCE technical support and follow‑up to avoid downtime. Escalates issues to the WCE Manager as required. Engages rig teams, OEMs, and customers on proactive planning and execution of agreed IBWM scopes, out‑of‑service periods, and in‑field work. Ensures IBWM plans are submitted on time, reviewed, and executed. Participates in PDCL calls for associated rigs. Assists in operator forums and customer requests as directed by the WCE manager. Works with OEM CSA teams to ensure personnel and parts are in place for work scopes. Assists in management of WCE support team deployments offshore. Leads procedural reviews for subsea testing procedures in CMMS, captures improvements, and updates procedures. Ensures subsea failures component D&I reports are reviewed with OEMs and root causes assigned. Participates in root cause failure analysis (RCFA) follow‑up with OEMs and third parties. Leads offshore subsea assessments or supports through the team. Follows up on rig and division actions resulting from assessments. Identifies improvement opportunities from planning through to execution and communicates them to the WCE manager. Education and Experience Minimum education: some college experience. Minimum required: 8–10 years of related experience. Preferred: 10–12 years of related experience. Skills Excellent communication skills. Good understanding of class and regulatory requirements. Excellent organization and interpersonal skills. Strong technical writing skills. Advanced technical knowledge of BOP and BOP controls systems. Location Candidate must live and work in Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Manager, Service Delivery Planning
vagas.description: This role is responsible for managing the Service Delivery Planning team, which provides pre-sales support to the Sales and Solutions Engineering across all Verticals, for complex Managed and Professional Services. The role requires a strong control of the project pipeline and good forecasting capabilities to support the department’s ability to plan for resources, hardware inventory, and agreements with Service Delivery Partners. The Manager of the Service Delivery Planning team is accountable for optimizing controllable Cost of Sales for opportunities in the pre-sales phase, by ensuring that existing inventory is leveraged where practical and by enforcing adherence to the partnership strategy established with key Service Delivery Partners. This role requires intense cross-team collaboration with leaders across the business, Engineering and Operations teams, as well as with external stakeholders. The Manager develops the team, hires the right talent, and creates a culture of forward movement and accountability. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS Build and develop a strong team with multi-disciplinary and diverse talent, spread throughout the world for best-in-class pre-sales support to Solutions Engineers and Sales. Organize Service Implementation Planning activities for all Managed and Professional Services, with focus put on most complex solutions that require extensive orchestration across Engineering, Operations, and Service Delivery. Develop relationships with internal customers in the Vertical Markets and Product Management. Support strategic customer meetings and presentations. Work with the Field Services organization to develop an ecosystem that matches the needs of SES’ Service Portfolio. Leverage your excellent understanding of the customer base and market demand to craft optimal plans for complex and strategic deals, optimizing time to revenue and profitability. Provide actionable reports to partners across the Service Delivery organization and leaders in Vertical Markets to align forecasting and readiness levels, thus effectively supporting critical in-year revenue. Maintain up to date knowledge on SES products and industry technology. COMPETENCIES Excellent written and verbal communications. Ability to commune internally and externally with confidence on all field related matters. Demonstrable problem-solving skills, using industry standard methods and best practices. Self-starting, solutions orientated with an elevated level of personal accountability. Ability to challenge and be challenged, while maintaining balance, and thoughtful consideration of other parties always. Ability to work in an everchanging environment while still maintaining a high degree of accuracy in all things. A team player that can manage and work into a cross functional team that are geographically separated. Aware of social and cultural differences and the need to respect all. A challenger of poor behaviour and a champion of diversity. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE A four-year college degree in Engineering or business. At least 10 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Program Management or Sales Engineering in the Telecommunications industry. Good knowledge of the economics and operations of telecommunications networks. Strong interpersonal skills and cultural awareness. Effective written and verbal communication skills and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audience in English. Proficiency in a second language, preferably Spanish, French, or Portuguese. Proven ability to work in a cross-functional team environment and retain a positive attitude while simultaneously handling multiple complex projects with demanding schedules. Experience working in matrixed organization and demonstrated ability to influence key stakeholders. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills. Excellent organizational skills. Conciliación de cuentas: Verificar que depósitos coincidan con facturas y revisar comprobantes electrónicos. Reducción de morosidad: Implementar acciones y estrategias para garantizar el flujo de ingresos. Seguimiento a casos críticos: Dar trazabilidad a cuentas vencidas y reportar avances al Coordinador Administrativo. Control documental: Asegurar que arrendatarios cuenten con facturas, complementos y notas de crédito. Actualización de información: Revisar contratos, adeudos y reportes de cobranza de manera constante. Elaboración de reportes: Envío diario de avances y estatus de cobranza. Necesitas Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Contabilidad, Finanzas, Administración o carrera afín. Experiencia: 2 a 3 años en roles similares: cobranza, auxiliar contable, facturación o administración. Software: Manejo de ERP (SAP, Oracle, etc.) y Excel intermedio–avanzado. Conocimientos deseables Procesos administrativos y contables. Manejo de comprobantes fiscales. Conciliaciones bancarias. Atención al detalle, tolerancia a la frustración, orientación al cliente. Beneficios Sueldo base en bruto. Prestaciones de Ley. Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores. Seguro de Vida. Colliers brinda igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todas las personas. Ningún candidato será discriminado debido a su raza, credo, origen, estado civil, orientación sexual, edad, discapacidad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: VIGILANTE EVENTOS INTERMITENTE DIARISTA - RIO DE JANEIRO - RJ
vagas.description: Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo! Nosso propósito é tornar o mundo um lugar mais seguro e nós não vamos parar até conseguir. Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 26 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo, somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece soluções integradas de segurança adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes. Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho! O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro / Cash Atuar na segurança patrimonial e controle de acesso em grandes eventos. Responsabilidades Realizar revista preventiva de pessoas e objetos, conforme procedimentos. Monitorar áreas estratégicas, prevenindo riscos e incidentes. Garantir a ordem e segurança do público, colaboradores e artistas. Apoiar em situações de emergência, seguindo protocolos de segurança. REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDÍVEIS PARA A INSCRIÇÃO Ensino médio completo. Curso de Vigilante com reciclagem em dia. Extensão de Grandes Eventos / Eventos Sociais. * Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse, junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser protagonista de uma história de sucesso! #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Responsabilidades Executar atividades de atendimento a passageiros e serviços de suporte em aeroportos, desde o momento da compra do bilhete até o desembarque, atuando dentro dos procedimentos operacionais com empatia e simpatia para buscar a satisfação dos clientes.
