vagas.title: AZZAS F&L | Especialista de Projetos Estratégicos | Labs
vagas.description: Vale transporte Parceria com o SESC No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias. Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Projetos Estratégicos para atuar diretamente com a liderança de Tecnologia, dentro da nossa iniciativa de IA corporativa. É uma posição para quem gosta de entrar em problemas complexos, conduzir análises profundas com autonomia e sair com recomendações que geram decisão e impacto. O trabalho é variado por natureza: a cada ciclo, uma oportunidade diferente do negócio — identificada pela alta liderança — pode virar o seu próximo projeto. O que você vai fazer Atuar como braço analítico ligado diretamente ao diretor de Tecnologia. À medida que a alta liderança identifica oportunidades relevantes no negócio, esta posição é alocada para entrar no problema, conduzir a análise de ponta a ponta e sair com recomendações concretas e acionáveis — atuando também na implementação quando o projeto pedir. O que buscamos 4 a 5 anos de experiência em funções analíticas exigentes — consultoria estratégica, estratégia/BizOps, M&A, banco de investimento, ou áreas equivalentes. Capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos e conduzi-los até uma recomendação concreta com pouca supervisão. Raciocínio quantitativo forte e conforto com dados (SQL e/ou Python são diferenciais relevantes). Comunicação executiva clara — escrita e verbal — com diretoria e C-level. Fluência ou disposição genuína em usar ferramentas de IA como parte central do trabalho analítico. Autonomia, senso de dono e maturidade para navegar diferentes áreas do grupo. Diferenciais (nice to have) Experiência em concepção ou desenvolvimento de produtos/projetos digitais. Vivência em ambientes de varejo, moda, e-commerce ou bens de consumo. Responsabilidades e atribuições Decompor problemas de negócio ambíguos em hipóteses claras, frentes de análise e um plano de ataque — partindo de um direcionamento inicial da liderança e conduzindo o resto com autonomia. Conduzir análises quantitativas e qualitativas robustas: estruturar dados, dimensionar oportunidades, modelar cenários e pressionar as próprias conclusões antes de apresentá-las. Entregar complete staff work: chegar até o final do raciocínio e apresentar recomendações prontas para decisão, com trade‑offs explícitos e premissas declaradas — não análises em aberto que devolvem o problema para quem pediu. Usar ferramentas de IA como alavanca central de análise — acelerando pesquisa, processamento de dados, prototipagem de soluções e geração de insumos para decisão. Traduzir análise em comunicação executiva: documentos e apresentações diretos, bem estruturados e proporcionais à decisão em jogo, voltados a CEO e diretoria. Participar da implementação das recomendações quando aplicável — acompanhando execução, ajustando o curso com base em resultados e garantindo que a análise vire impacto real. Trabalhar lado a lado com as áreas donas de cada problema, navegando contextos distintos do grupo (marcas, varejo, operações, digital) sem gerar atrito de "área que audita área". Requisitos e qualificações Ensino superior completo em Exatas (Administração, Engenharias, Matemática, etc.). Domínio de Excel avançado. Conhecimento em programação (SQL) e banco de dados. Experiência em varejo e projetos será considerado um diferencial. Experiência com ferramentas de IA será considerado um diferencial. Nossos Benefícios Esta empresa oferece um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem‑estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história. Saúde e bem estar Plano de saúde. Plano odontológico. Seguro de vida. Programas de bem‑estar físico, como Wellhub ou TotalPass. Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental. Dia a dia e qualidade de vida Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash. Vale transporte. Parceria com o SESC. Clube de vantagens com parceiros. Day off de aniversário. Extensão de licença maternidade. Extensão de licença paternidade. Descontos nas marcas do grupo. Desenvolvimento e crescimento Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento. Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas. Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento. Reconhecimento Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente. Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia. Sonhar grande para fazer gigante, com gente boa e do bem. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Principal Package Management Spec
vagas.description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Brazil, Belo Horizonte; Brazil, Campinas; Brazil, Rio[...]
vagas.description: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page About the Role Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking for a Person Who Has Must-have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections. Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice-to-have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. Chance of earning equity at Nubank Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses #J-18808-Ljbffr

Nossa missão também se estende na vida de cada colaborador que representa a nossa marca. Aqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas, pois acreditamos que é o nosso bem mais precioso, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho leve e com um clima agradável, no qual todos são respeitados e valorizados, independente de raça, gênero, etnia, orientação sexual ou deficiências. Além disso, aqui na Swift, trabalhamos muito para que o nosso time cresça conosco, podendo construir uma carreira emocionante junto a nós, tendo a possibilidade de fazer a diferença. Então, se você se identificou com o nosso jeito de ser e quer ajudar a construir essa história, convidamos você a fazer parte do nosso time! Responsabilidades e atribuições Principais Responsabilidades Conferir notas fiscais, romaneios e demais documentos de recebimento e expedição. Validar a quantidade de volumes recebidos, identificando possíveis divergências. Verificar avarias, faltas ou excessos de mercadorias durante os processos de recebimento e expedição. Garantir que os materiais recebidos estejam em conformidade com os pedidos e documentos correspondentes. Validar e registrar movimentações de estoque, assegurando a acuracidade das informações. Realizar auditorias de posições de estoque e participar de inventários rotativos e gerais. Conferir pedidos separados antes do carregamento, verificando quantidades, lotes e datas de validade quando aplicável. Liberar cargas para embarque após a conferência e validação dos itens. Investigar divergências de estoque e apoiar a identificação de suas causas. Efetuar ajustes de estoque mediante aprovação e conforme procedimentos internos. Zelar pela organização, integridade e rastreabilidade dos materiais armazenados. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino fundamental completo. WMS – sistema de gerenciamento de armazém. Pacote Office Básico (Word, Excel e PowerPoint). Informações adicionais Refeitório no local ou Vale Refeição. Vale‑Alimentação flexível, para usar como quiser. Vale‑Transporte. Experiência Swift (mensalmente oferecemos um produto diferenciado para que todos os nossos colaboradores possam experimentar, se deliciar e aprimorar seus argumentos de venda). Acesso ao Sempre JBS (aplicativo interno): Sempre Cuida: oferece acesso gratuito para cuidar do seu bem‑estar (saúde mental, física, nutricional, dentre outras). Sempre Educa: disponibiliza conteúdos de treinamentos corporativos, incentivando o seu desenvolvimento profissional. Sempre Cresce: dedicado a oportunidades de carreira no grupo JBS, para que você possa crescer com a gente. Compras na loja com repasse em folha. Parceria com o Gympass (convênio de academias). Participação dos resultados (pagamento realizado uma vez por ano de acordo com o resultado da companhia). Fretado do Terminal Jardim Britânia até a Swift X Swift até o Jardim Britânia. Assistência Médica/Odontológica e Seguro de vida (opcionais). Descontos em Instituições de Ensino e de Idiomas (opcional). Quem Somos Somos um varejo multicanal especializado em proteínas congeladas. De bovinos a pescados, aqui temos tudo para os nossos clientes. Trabalhamos sempre com foco em excelência, segurança alimentar, sustentabilidade e inovação. Temos mais de 500 lojas divididas em: lojas físicas, lojas nos principais supermercados, lojas móveis que circulam pelos condomínios em diversas cidades e também uma loja online para que os clientes comprem como, quando e onde quiser. O nosso papel é estar cada vez mais próximo dos nossos clientes, através de uma experiência de compra e consumo com qualidade, preço justo, ambiente de compra agradável, praticidade e segurança, alimentando o mundo com o que há de melhor. E tudo isso só acontece pois temos um grande diferencial: nossas pessoas, que colocam paixão em tudo o que fazem. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Juntos, ultrapassamos os limites da ciência para unir saúde e beleza em benefício de todos, porque cada vez que cuidamos de uma pessoa, tornamos o mundo inteiro melhor. A pessoa será responsável por liderar a estratégia de vendas e trade digital para grandes players, com foco em impulsionar crescimento, visibilidade e conversão nos canais online. O que esperamos de você: Liderar o planejamento estratégico de vendas e trade para os principais clientes digitais: Amazon, Raia, Mercado Livre, Beleza na Web; Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de growth, visibilidade, conversão e share no ambiente digital; Monitorar e analisar indicadores-chave como sell out, share de gôndola digital, visibilidade, conversão e competitividade do portfólio; Definir e acompanhar KPIs críticos para performance digital, garantindo aderência às metas regionais e globais; Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas promocionais digitais (banners, newsletters, cupons, Big Moments, Master Classes, lives); Gerenciar eficiência das iniciativas, maximizando ROI e ROAS para cada parceiro digital; Acompanhar calendário promocional dos clientes e competir estrategicamente pelos espaços de destaque; Produzir análises de performance integrando dados de e-commerce, trade e execução; Propor ações corretivas e estratégicas baseadas em dados para impulsionar vendas e eficiência comercial; Atuar em colaboração com Marketing, Vendas, Supply Chain e demais áreas internas. Um pouco do que oferecemos: Um ambiente acolhedor, com desafios e oportunidades de crescimento, que preza pelo equilíbrio entre a vida pessoal e o trabalho; Vale Refeição; Plano de Saúde e Odontológico; E muito mais. O que esperamos de você: Graduação completa; Experiência consolidada em e-commerce; Vivência em gestão comercial; Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes. Presente em 120 países com uma equipe de mais de 10.000 colaboradores, temos orgulho de criar impacto científico e humano, hoje e amanhã! Se cuidar está no coração dos seus valores, junte‑se aos Laboratórios Pierre Fabre e torne‑se um ator essencial do “We Care Movement.” Nos Laboratórios Pierre Fabre, acreditamos que nosso maior patrimônio são as pessoas. Temos uma política global de Igualdade de Oportunidades de Emprego e não discriminaremos um candidato ou colaborador com base em raça, cor, religião, credo, origem nacional ou ascendência, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, deficiência física ou mental, status de veterano ou militar, informação genética ou qualquer outra base legalmente protegida sob leis federais, estaduais ou locais. As informações coletadas por esta candidatura destinam‑se exclusivamente a determinar a adequação ao emprego, verificar identidade e manter estatísticas de emprego sobre os candidatos. Candidatos com deficiência podem ter direito a acomodação razoável conforme a Americans with Disabilities Act e certas leis estaduais ou locais. Por favor, informe o representante de pessoal da empresa se você precisar de assistência para completar esta candidatura ou para participar do processo seletivo. Ao se candidatar a esta vaga você está ciente que será necessário o fornecimento de algumas informações pessoais a seu respeito (“dados pessoais”) à empresa para possibilitar sua identificação no processo seletivo, bem como para que a referida empresa possa entrar em contato com você. A empresa não compartilhará seus dados pessoais com terceiros sem a sua autorização, a menos que seja legalmente obrigada a fazê-lo, e seus dados pessoais permanecerão armazenados pelo período máximo de 2 anos a contar da data de fornecimento, ou da última atualização de sua candidatura à vaga. Caso você seja contratado, estes dados poderão ser armazenados por um período maior em decorrência da elaboração e execução do contrato de trabalho. Para mais informações sobre como é feito o tratamento de seus dados pessoais, bem como seus direitos enquanto titular de dados, você pode enviar uma solicitação ao Encarregado da Pierre Fabre. Estamos convencidos de que a diversidade é uma fonte de realização, equilíbrio social e complementaridade para nossos funcionários, razão pela qual nossas ofertas estão abertas a todos, sem restrições. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Digital Product Manager
vagas.description: Job Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Position The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. Key Responsibilities Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first-party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament-time digital operations, delivering high-traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross-functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Providing clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross-functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer-first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI-driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data-driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. Education & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline. Relevant product development philosophies, e.g. Agile, are essential. Relevant project management qualifications, e.g. PRINCE2, highly beneficial. Work Experience 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end-to-end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct-to-consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal – to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short-term opportunities. Competencies Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data-driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology Strong knowledge of digital direct-to-consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry-standard solutions, e.g. Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: MECHANICAL ENGINEER
vagas.description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy at depths and in conditions that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our mission is to make geothermal a scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling reliable, efficient drilling in hard, hot rock. With engineering teams in the USA, Brazil, the UK, and across Europe, we are progressing rapidly toward commercial deployment of our technologies. We are seeking a mechanical engineer with a practical bias to perform mechanical design for downhole drilling systems and associated equipment related to assembly, testing, and maintenance. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable working with established processes and procedures or helping to develop and refine new ones. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. You will have the opportunity to positively impact technology and processes as we move from prototype builds to commercial operations. Responsibilities Mechanical Design & Analysis Perform mechanical design and analysis of components and systems for drilling technologies and associated tooling and test equipment. Develop high-fidelity, multi-domain (hydraulic, mechanical, control) dynamic models of actuation systems using tools such as Simscape and MATLAB/Simulink. Perform stress calculations and analyze the impact of drilling fluid properties (viscosity, density, temperature) on hydraulic performance and response time, and use engineering judgement to recommend suitable design solutions. Generate high-quality engineering documentation — drawings, calculations, procedures, and reports — and contribute to design reviews, technical risk management, and equipment integration and commissioning. Assembly, Testing & Field Support Assist with equipment assembly, disassembly, maintenance, repair, and testing, including creating and refining the associated processes and procedures. Diagnose and repair equipment failures, support failure reporting, and work with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality & Compliance to elevate and resolve technical or quality issues. Provide hands‑on support during builds, tests, and field deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Support manufacturing, supply chain, and external suppliers to ensure seamless equipment deployment, and assist with project requirements, budgeting, timelines, and specifications. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of mechanical engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Strong grounding in mechanical engineering fundamentals, with experience in component design and manufacturing for industrial equipment. Proficiency with computer-aided design and analysis applications (CAD, CFD, FEA). Design justification experience via analysis and calculation — FEA, stress, and thermal calculations. Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards and legislation. Experience with equipment troubleshooting and report generation for complex mechanical or electromechanical systems. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to read technical documentation, drawings, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality & Compliance, and external suppliers to support equipment builds, deployments, and resolution of technical issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail, accuracy, and documentation discipline across drawings, calculations, procedures, and reports. Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing project plans from high-level direction and delivering reliably against schedule and milestones. Pragmatic decision‑maker, able to weigh business priorities and contribute to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in test environments, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, equally comfortable working with established processes or helping to develop and refine new ones. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Familiarity with electromechanical fundamentals and the assembly, maintenance, and testing of complex electromechanical systems. Experience with hydraulics, and with drilling tool design. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
vagas.description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, control, and project management to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking an engineer with 5+ years' experience in power-electronics design, testing, and manufacturing, as well as prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. The ideal candidate will be equally well versed in design, analysis, and test. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the development of power-electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems for our downhole drilling technologies. The role spans schematic design, prototype bring-up, validation testing, and field support — working closely with mechanical, firmware, and systems engineers, and providing direct technical support to operations and drilling crews during testing and deployments. Responsibilities Design & Development Develop power electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems and control applications. Create system block diagrams, schematics, wiring harnesses, and detailed electrical designs using engineering CAD software. Design and implement electrical stress tests (e.g., pressure, temperature, vibration) to ensure product reliability and durability. Look ahead at validation requirements, and develop and execute test plans and setups using both firmware and hardware debugging tools. Testing, Validation & Field Support Conduct prototype board bring-up, functional testing, and performance analysis. Troubleshoot electronic faults at the component and system level using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. Provide technical support to field service technicians and on-site drilling crews to resolve operational problems. Collaborate across mechanical, firmware, systems, and project teams on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture and ensure that all activities adhere to HSE policy. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of power electronics engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Experience with high-voltage transmission and protection, and motor control electronic circuits (motor drivers, position feedback) used in oil & gas drilling, electric actuators, automation systems, electric vehicles, and similar applications. Experience with DC-DC converters (Buck/Boost, Flyback) used in power supplies across industrial and consumer electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Experience with analog and digital filters used across transmission networks, radio, satellite, medical devices, and oil & gas sensors and signal monitoring. Experience with sensors found in industrial and commercial electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Proficiency with electronics simulation and CAD tools used to model, simulate, and design electronic devices. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong analytical thinking and ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working directly with operations teams, field service technicians, and on-site drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and resolution of operational problems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Strong attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and configuration control. Demonstrated ability to work independently, execute project plans from high-level direction, and deliver reliably against schedule and milestones. Experience contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working in the lab, on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping evolve them as systems mature. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSEE or MSEE preferred. Experience with embedded firmware development for high-voltage or motor control applications. Exposure to oil & gas, drilling, or downhole electronics qualification standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

qualification, certification and licensing criteria within Brazil and its federal states relevant to guarding, stewarding, close protection and related disciplines Design and implement a bespoke capability‑building strategy for internal staff and external security suppliers Design and deliver security training programmes tailored to specific roles (e.g. security guards, stewards, supervisors, managers, TSLOs/RSLOs and direct hires) Develop and implement a structured training curriculum and training materials aligned with the Safety & Security Strategy and Operational Plan Design, develop and implement analogue and digital training solutions, including instructor‑led programmes, workshops and e‑learning packages, ensuring scalable, accessible and role‑specific learning delivery across all safety and security personnel Define readiness criteria and certification processes for safety and security personnel prior to deployment Establish systems to track workforce competence, training completion and deployment readiness across all official tournament sites Coordinate and oversee joint exercises, table‑top simulations, venue rehearsals and scenario‑based drills to test operational response and inter‑agency coordination Design and implement programmes to ensure compliance with statutory qualification and licensing standards on site, including the development of quality control audit processes Engage with safety and security suppliers to ensure that capability‑building programmes are delivered effectively and that all personnel are trained before commencing work Coordinate with other FWWC2027 functional areas to ensure alignment on policies, procedures and response protocols Oversee the delivery and evaluation of drills, simulations and readiness exercises to ensure operational effectiveness Identify training gaps and implement corrective actions through continuous improvement processes Conduct on‑site quality control audits to verify training completion, certification and operational competence Support senior management and site management in verifying training‑related supplier invoices and compliance documentation YOUR PROFILE Education University degree in security management, education and training, public safety, risk management or a related field Professional training qualification or certification (e.g. instructional design, adult learning, security training accreditation) is desirable Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in safety and security training, workforce readiness or operational preparedness roles Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured training programmes in large‑scale operational environments Experience coordinating exercises, simulations and multi‑agency readiness activities Familiarity with Brazilian licensing and qualification requirements in the security sector Experience working with public security authorities and private security suppliers Skills & Competencies Strong instructional design and training delivery capability Structured and analytical approach to readiness measurement and workforce tracking Excellent organisational and project management skills Ability to coordinate complex multi‑stakeholder exercises and rehearsals Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement capability Clear written and verbal communication skills Advanced IT proficiency vagas.title: MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
vagas.description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, and control to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking a mechanical technician with 3+ years' experience in lab and field testing of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for downhole drilling systems, including assembly, prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the hands‑on assembly, testing, and maintenance of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for our downhole drilling systems — running functional and performance tests in the lab and supporting prototype bring‑up, qualification campaigns, and operational deployments in the field. You will work alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, capturing test data and feeding it back into design and reliability improvements. Responsibilities Conduct functional tests, performance evaluations, and calibrations on mechanical and electromechanical equipment to ensure compliance with quality standards and manufacturer specifications. Set up and operate test equipment — pressure and temperature test rigs, hydraulic test benches, torque tools, dimensional metrology (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and data acquisition systems — to run characterization, qualification, and acceptance testing. Diagnose and repair mechanical and hydraulic failures at the component and assembly level, including disassembly, inspection, replacement of worn or damaged parts, and rework of seals, fasteners, and fittings. Support prototype bring‑up and design iterations by capturing test data, flagging anomalies, and feeding observations back to mechanical and systems engineers. Assembly, Field Support & Documentation Assemble, disassemble, inspect, and perform preventative maintenance on mechanical and hydraulic equipment (downhole tools, actuators, drillstring components, pumps, valves, and associated test fixtures) according to technical specifications and procedures. Maintain accurate service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation, and generate clear reports on work performed and equipment status. Provide hands‑on support to field representatives and drilling crews during qualification campaigns and deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Coordinate with other technicians, engineers, and field representatives to resolve complex issues, support failure analysis, and ensure seamless equipment deployment. Help maintain an organized work environment and manage inventory of electronic components, parts, and supplies. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Develop scripts and small tools for simulation workflows, data processing, and result visualization. Analyze simulation outputs and summarize findings in clear technical reports. Read engineering drawings, schematics, and requirements to translate physical systems into model inputs and assumptions. Collaborate with engineers across disciplines on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Follow health, safety, environmental, and quality procedures. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge Degree, advanced coursework, or equivalent practical experience in mechanical, mechatronics, aerospace, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field. Academic, internship, lab, or project experience with simulation, numerical methods, physics-based modeling, or engineering analysis. Basic understanding of mechanics, fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, system modeling, or numerical methods. Programming ability in Python and C++ for engineering scripts, simulation workflows, and data processing. Ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering instructions. Clear written and verbal communication for collaboration and technical reporting. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Analytical thinking, curiosity, and comfort asking for guidance when information is incomplete. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Willingness to engage with engineering teams, test personnel, and — under guidance — customer-facing activities to support testing and troubleshooting. Clear communication skills, with the ability to capture test observations and translate them into structured notes and engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Attention to detail and a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and following configuration control practices. Ability to take ownership of clearly scoped tasks and see them through from preparation to close-out, asking for guidance when needed. Eagerness to contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions, learning from test and field results. Comfort working in fast-moving, technically challenging environments while maintaining rigor in your work. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong customer service orientation and ability to balance business urgency with technical standards and risk considerations. Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives and managing multiple priorities in a dynamic business environment. Knowledge of IT controls, cybersecurity awareness, asset management, and service management practices. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical topics clearly to non-technical audiences. vagas.title: Access Management Cluster Manager
vagas.description: Access Management Cluster Manager Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements on site and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. YOUR PROFILE Education: Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience: Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Avaliar e identificar as fases comprometidas da deglutição, observando estruturas e funcionamento, classificando disfagias e definindo condutas terapêuticas para reabilitação. Analisar e avaliar pacientes ao longo do tratamento, observando evolução, promovendo ajustes necessários na terapia adotada e emitindo laudos e pareceres técnicos baseados no histórico de cada paciente. Participar da elaboração de protocolos de tratamento junto à equipe multidisciplinar, definindo diretrizes em relação a cada área específica e afins. Participar das discussões clínicas (rounds) e reuniões de equipe. vagas.title: ENFERMEIRO(A) NAVEGADOR ONCOLÓGICO
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga A ECO – Espaço de Cuidados Oncológicos é um centro de infusão especializado em tratamentos infusionais. Atuamos com foco na jornada do paciente oncológico, oferecendo cuidado humanizado, seguro e de alta complexidade. Nossa missão é garantir que cada pessoa receba o tratamento certo, no momento certo, com o suporte necessário do início ao fim do processo terapêutico. Somos uma equipe comprometida e multidisciplinar, onde cada colaborador tem papel direto no cuidado ao paciente e na qualidade dos processos assistenciais. Responsabilidades e atribuições O Enfermeiro Navegador é o elo entre o paciente, a família e a equipe multidisciplinar. Sua função é identificar barreiras que dificultam o acesso ao tratamento sejam elas clínicas, emocionais, sociais ou administrativas e atuar ativamente para removê-las. É um profissional de referência: alguém que o paciente conhece pelo nome, que acompanha sua trajetória e que garante que nenhuma etapa do cuidado se perca no caminho. O que você vai fazer Acompanhar a jornada do paciente oncológico desde o diagnóstico até o término do tratamento, atuando como referência de cuidado Identificar e remover barreiras de acesso ao tratamento — clínicas, emocionais, sociais ou operacionais Orientar pacientes e familiares sobre o plano terapêutico, etapas do tratamento e suporte disponível Coordenar o fluxo assistencial entre equipe médica, enfermagem, administrativo e outros serviços de saúde Monitorar indicadores de adesão ao tratamento e qualidade de vida dos pacientes Realizar contatos ativos com pacientes para acompanhamento entre sessões Registrar evolução e intercorrências no sistema de gestão, garantindo rastreabilidade do cuidado Articular suporte psicossocial, nutricional e de outras especialidades quando necessário Requisitos e qualificações Graduação em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN. Candidatos sem formação em enfermagem não serão considerados neste processo seletivo. Especialização em Enfermagem Oncológica ou Gestão do Cuidado Experiência em ambiente oncológico ou de alta complexidade Habilidade de comunicação clara, empática e assertiva com pacientes e familiares Capacidade de coordenar múltiplos casos simultaneamente com organização e priorização Perfil proativo, resolutivo e com escuta ativa apurada Inteligência emocional para atuar com pacientes em situações de vulnerabilidade Informações adicionais Especialização em Enfermagem Oncológica ou Gestão do Cuidado Experiência prévia como navegador ou gestor de caso em oncologia Conhecimento em cuidados paliativos e suporte psicossocial Familiaridade com indicadores de qualidade assistencial e sistemas de gestão em saúde #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Software Developer, Level II - SeaPower
vagas.description: About this position Build your career with Kraken Robotics. Make a difference to others. If innovation drives you, and you want a career that makes a difference to the world, helping humanity overcome the challenges in our oceans – safely, efficiently, and sustainably – then come join us at Kraken Robotics. Kraken Robotics is currently seeking a Software Developer, Level II - SeaPower . This position can be fully remote within Brazil or hybrid/in-office in Rio de Janeiro or Salvador. The Software Developer Level II will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining backend software components within Kraken’s SeaPower ecosystem. This role involves working on features and tools that support Kraken’s subsea battery systems—such as battery chargers, diagnostic applications, and simulation models for batteries and power communication systems. The position requires ownership of assigned development tasks, collaboration with cross‑functional teams, and active participation in all stages of the software development lifecycle. Operating within a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment, the Intermediate Developer will contribute to delivering reliable, high‑quality software while expanding technical skills and influencing product direction. Roles and Responsibilities Feature Development: Independently design, implement, test, and maintain backend components within the SeaPower application ecosystem, ensuring code quality and alignment with project requirements. Software Development Lifecycle: Take active ownership of assigned features through all development stages, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation. Code Review & Mentorship: Participate in code reviews to maintain high-quality standards and begin providing guidance and feedback to junior developers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, hardware teams, and other engineers to coordinate development efforts and deliver features on schedule. Test Automation & DevOps: Contribute to enhancing test coverage and improving CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Requirements Analysis: Collaborate in refining functional and technical requirements, helping to translate them into clear, actionable development tasks. Documentation & Process Adherence: Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation and adhere to established software development processes and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience Educational Background Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Nice to have: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields. Professional Experience 3-6 years’ experience with high-level device software development, tools, and practices. Strong proficiency in Linux-based system development. Strong knowledge of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), STL, and object-oriented design. Experience writing automated tests: unit, integration and end-to-end. Familiarity with build systems (CMake, Make) and debugging tools (gdb, Valgrind). Experience using development tools and libraries such as Git, GTest. Familiarity with containerization using Docker. Nice to have Knowledge of basic electrical engineering concepts. Exposure to microservice development using gRPC/protobuf. Experience with Python. Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies. Experience with software‑hardware interaction and system‑level design. Exposure to CI/CD technologies, especially GitLab CI and/or Buildbot. Experience with Autoproj or other build systems for robotics. Experience with robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS or ROS2). Experience with simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo). Personal Skills Self‑motivated and capable of working independently. Ability to adapt to changing work environments and manage competing demands. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team environment. Willingness to Travel At least once a quarter to one of Kraken's offices if fully remote. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Access Management Cluster Manager Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. THE POSITION Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements on site and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. YOUR PROFILE Education: Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience: Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Arrivals & Departures Manager
vagas.description: Arrivals & Departures Manager Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The Arrivals & Departures Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering all Arrivals & Departures operations for and during the tournament. This role ensures seamless, safe, and efficient transportation services for all FIFA client groups and spectators, guaranteeing operational readiness and flawless delivery on all airports used for the tournament. The position also liaises closely with the Airport Operators, Federal Government and Host City authorities. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager and oversees key arrivals and departures sub-projects, including international and inter-city planning and operations, as well as aviation venue management. The Arrivals & Departures Manager collaborates closely with Airport Operators, Federal Government agencies, Host City authorities, the LFS Senior Transport Manager, the Transport Government Liaison & Integration Manager, and FIFA to define and implement an integrated concept of operations for Arrivals & Departures services. It is also the responsibility of this position to develop airport operational plans that provide essential support to both the Transport Functional Area and Event Services. The successful candidate is expected to be a proactive and resilient professional, capable of leading and managing a team while operating efficiently under pressure and delivering to strict timelines. Managing the area’s activities and resources within the approved budget is also a key component of the role. The Arrivals & Departures Manager must ensure strong integration with all other FWWC2027 functional areas present at the airport—including Workforce, Volunteers, Guest Operations & Protocol Etiquette, Team Services, and IT—to ensure alignment with established FIFA SLAs and the seamless delivery of airport operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Designing and implementing a suitable A&D service model that covers all tournament airports, to service all FIFA Constituent Groups (Teams, Referees, FIFA Officials, VIPs, Workforce, Dignitaries, Media, Broadcast, Commercial Affiliates) at all official point-of-entry/exit sites, based on FIFA requirements and agreed service levels including but not limited to: Final Draw Team Workshops FWWC2027 Tournament Test Events Any other official side events Designing the initial structure of International and Inter-city Arrivals and Departures / Aviation and Airport Management sub-projects including but not limited to A&D Information management, Venue planning, Constituent Group requirements, Tournament time operations. Planning and implementation of an Arrivals & Departures Plan for each FIFA Constituent Group based on FIFA requirements and service levels. Negotiating with the airport authorities and government agencies to ensure that all the structures and procedures of the airports are aligned to deliver the best operation on peak throughout the FWWC2027 operational period. Designing the concept of operations, the venue operating plan, and all relevant A&D policies and procedures. Integration with others LFS Transport workstreams functions within Event Transport for Airport pick-ups and drop-offs. Coordination with meet and greet companies regarding VIP arrivals and departures services. Contributing to the slot’s allocation plan of the HC Airports for the period of the tournament ensuring that priority is given to the FWWC2027-related aircraft movements (mainly PMA charter flights and FIFA VIP private jets). Ensuring successful integration of the FWWC2027 air traffic into the overall international airline schedule. Participate proactively in the Airport/ Mobility Working Groups and ensure (via close collaboration with HC Transport, Civil Aviation and Airport Operators and Authorities) that the air traffic match the airports and terminal capacities. Planning and development (in coordination with Airport Authorities, HC Transport, and other FWWC2027 Functional Areas (Security, Logistics, Team Services, Guest Operations, Marketing, etc.) the tournament time Operational Plan for the Airport (Airside and Landside Operations). Ensuring integration of the Airport Operational Plan with the Airport Transportation Plan, as well as correlation with all other Transport services and operations. Delivery of the final operational plan and ensure successful and smooth operations for all constituent groups. Implementing Project Management within A&D and Airport management, identifying key milestones of International and Inter-city Arrivals and Departures / Aviation and Airport Management sub-projects. Identifying and addressing key risks of International and Inter-city Arrivals and Departures / Aviation and Airport Management sub-projects. Content preparation (slides, handouts, etc.) and preparation of reports for the FWWC2027 related management meetings and working group meetings. Support recruiting, hiring each Host City A&D Manager, assigning responsibilities, and managing the Team from planning through delivery. Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all Airports. Ensure all Airport staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of operational workshops and briefings, and role‑specific instructions. This HQ manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities Airports. Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions. Support test events, rehearsals, and operational readiness exercises. Oversee the installation and readiness of signage, transport desk, wayfinding etc. Maintain constant live communication with the Transport Command and Control, providing real‑time updates on airport operations, incidents, delays, and any emerging issues. Ensure that all critical issue is escalated promptly, enabling rapid decision‑making and coordinated responses across all transport functions, Government agencies and Airports operators. This includes monitoring on‑ground conditions, reporting deviations from the plan, and implementing solutions to ensure smooth and uninterrupted service delivery. YOUR PROFILE Qualifications Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project Management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Experience Minimum of ten (10) years of event Arrivals and Departures (Airport Operations) experience in international major events in at least three (3) world‑class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. Minimum of five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project. Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale. Proven experience of managing Airport Operations projects of a similar size and scale. Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships. Skills Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles. Advanced knowledge of teams' leadership, business process management. Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships. Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment. Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities. Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests. Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation. Proven project management skills within a complex project. Language skills - English language fluency both written and spoken. Strong analytical and organisation skills. Proven solution orientated decision-making skills. Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Bilingual - Portuguese and English. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro #J-18808-Ljbffr
