vagas.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Especialista Comercial - Hunter - RJ
vagas.description: Localização & Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido Nosso time de Marketplace trabalha com o modelo “híbrido”, sendo necessário estar disponível para eventuais reuniões presenciais com clientes na cidade duas vezes por mês. Etapas do Processo Seletivo Triagem People Interview Hiring Manager Interview Live Case Stakeholder Interview Offer Sobre a Área O Marketplace do QuintoAndar está em forte expansão pelo Brasil, e o sucesso desse movimento depende diretamente de conquistar as imobiliárias certas em cada praça . Para isso, estamos contratando Executivos(as) de Expansão — Hunters — que vão ser responsáveis por liderar o fechamento de parcerias com imobiliárias em sua praça de atuação. Esta é uma posição de frente de batalha : você vai pegar uma praça, conhecê‑la melhor do que ninguém, mapear quem importa, abrir portas com as imobiliárias mais estratégicas e fechar contratos que se traduzem em crescimento real para o negócio. Você terá apoio de um time de BDRs para gerar pipeline qualificado, mas o protagonismo da abordagem consultiva, da negociação e do fechamento é seu. Requisitos Experiência sólida em vendas B2B consultivas com foco em hunting e fechamento de novos clientes. Histórico comprovado de bater e superar metas. Perfil hunter de verdade: energia para abrir portas, resiliência para lidar com não e senso de urgência. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de argumentação , com facilidade para construir rapport com decisores sêniores e conduzir conversas com C-Level/donos de negócio. Habilidade de negociação consultiva , sabendo navegar objeções complexas, construir propostas ganha-ganha e fechar com disciplina comercial. Forte capacidade de mapeamento e leitura de mercado , identificando perfis com potencial de influência, engajamento e impacto na praça. Autonomia, organização e senso de dono. Domínio de CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar) e disciplina de pipeline/forecast. Disponibilidade para atuação em campo na praça sob sua responsabilidade. Diferenciais Vivência com imobiliárias, corretores de imóveis ou mercado imobiliário — ter rede e fluência no jargão do setor ajuda. Experiência em startups, scale-ups, proptechs ou marketplaces em fase de hipercrescimento. Familiaridade com metodologias estruturadas de venda. Conhecimento de funil de aquisição, testes de canal e experimentação comercial. Responsabilidades Ser dono(a) da praça sob sua responsabilidade: entender o mercado local, mapear as principais imobiliárias, identificar players de alta influência e priorizar contas com maior potencial de impacto. Liderar a prospecção ativa e o relacionamento com imobiliárias estratégicas, indo a campo quando necessário para construir confiança e destravar negócios. Conduzir todo o ciclo de venda consultiva: descoberta, demonstração de valor, construção de proposta, negociação de termos e fechamento do contrato de parceria. Bater (e superar) as metas individuais de fechamento de imobiliárias parceiras. Realizar abordagens consultivas com decisores (sócios, diretores, gestores), entendendo o contexto e as dores específicas de cada imobiliária e conectando‑as à proposta de valor do QuintoAndar. Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de BDRs no refinamento de pipeline, qualificação de oportunidades e priorização da carteira. Abrir portas em contas estratégicas onde a prospecção tradicional não basta — usando networking, eventos do setor, indicações e presença local como alavancas. Identificar e ativar perfis com potencial de influência, transformando parceiros em embaixadores e amplificadores na praça. Mapear continuamente o mercado da praça: clusters geográficos, perfis de imobiliária, movimentos da concorrência e oportunidades não óbvias. Construir relacionamento de longo prazo com decisores‑chave, mantendo proximidade mesmo após o fechamento para garantir engajamento e expansão da parceria. Testar novas estratégias de aquisição: canais, discursos, segmentações e formatos de oferta, capturando aprendizados que possam ser replicados em outras praças. Atuar como voz da praça internamente, trazendo insights de mercado para Produto, Marketing e Operações. Manter o pipeline rigorosamente atualizado no CRM, com forecast preciso e visibilidade clara da saúde dos deals. Acompanhar de perto seus indicadores de funil — taxa de conexão, conversão entre etapas, ciclo de venda, win rate, ticket médio — e usar esses números para ajustar a própria atuação. Contribuir para a construção de playbooks, pitches e melhores práticas que serão usados pelo time de Expansão como um todo. Colaborar com pares de outras praças, compartilhando aprendizados e elevando o nível do time. Importante O nosso processo seletivo começa na candidatura! Se você está realmente a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, foque nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno para todas as pessoas que investiram tempo em se candidatar. Toda comunicação é feita por e-mail, então fique atento às nossas mensagens e libere o domínio @quintoandar.com.br para que nossos e-mails não sejam parar no spam. Benefícios Salário competitivo PLR - Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Remuneração variável (Somente para vagas comerciais) Vale Refeição e Alimentação Plano de saúde Plano odontológico Seguro de vida Auxílio creche e Auxílio parentalidade atípica Wellhub Auxílio home office QuintoCare: Nosso programa de apoio (saúde mental, assistência social, apoio jurídico e financeiro) Licença parental estendida Dia livre de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais Clube de Benefícios (descontos em serviços do dia a dia) Descontos em instituições de ensino Kit leiturinha para crianças - Playkids Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem‑vindo por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público‑alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura. Privacidade e Proteção a Dados O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Senior Commercial Analyst, Gas and Power
vagas.description: ## Senior Commercial Analyst, Gas and PowerApplylocations: Rio De Janeiro, Braziltime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Todayjob requisition id: JR **Important!** To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on (dd.mm.yyyy): We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.# What does the job involve?Strategy and Business Development is the business unit within Marketing, Midstream and Processing at Equinor which is accountable for business development activities in MMP across the full range of MMP existing and emerging/future commodities and products. For oil & gas development, acquisition, and divestment projects, SBD is accountable for coordinating all marketing and midstream deliverables, including commercial analysis, mid- and downstream architecture, MMP negotiated agreements, optimal commodity route to market, and value uplift. In Brazil, this unit has the responsibility to ensure flow assurance for equity gas, which includes originating gas and natural gas liquids sales transactions, negotiating access to infrastructure, and balancing and optimizing from production to market the Equinor domestic gas portfolio. By joining our team in Marketing, Midstream & Processing you will have the opportunity to: Be a key contributor to achieving the unit’s ambition of developing a Brazil market position to capture value and secure flow assurance of our upstream portfolio. The successful candidate will work across the business, and the position provides the opportunity to shape the direction of Equinor’s market position in Brazil. This position will contribute to the structuring, negotiation and execution of commercial transactions, and provide analytical insight to support business decisions, while also contributing to shaping Equinor’s market position in Brazil.# What will my tasks be?Within this position, your key tasks will be to:* Contribute to origination, structuring and execution of gas sales transactions and related agreements.* Contribute to negotiation of gas sales, infrastructure access and commercial contracts.* Develop pricing models and support financial and risk assessment of transactions.* Identify and analyze value drivers, risks and optionality in structured agreements.* Monitor regulatory developments and market trends in gas and power markets.* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders (trading, operations, legal, risk) to support deal execution.* Contribute to development of new commercial products and solutions.# Here's what we expect from you:At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business or equivalent.* 7+ years Relevant experience in Brazilian energy markets, preferably gas or power commercialization with experience in commercial analysis or business development / deal structuring roles.* Strong analytical, financial modelling and problem-solving skills preferably with a knowledge of relevant tools, programs and automation processes.* An interest and knowledge of AI tools and processes would be beneficial for future integration and projects.* Effective communication and stakeholder engagement.* Collaborative mindset with an ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing environments.* Fluency in Portuguese and English.# What can we offer you?We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That’s why we offer:Not just a job - a careerIn Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.Attractive rewardsWe give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.Wellness and work-life balanceWe care about and prioritise our employees’ well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That’s why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.An inclusive cultureWe believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.# Equal opportunities for everyoneEquinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status.As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs. We also believe everyone should be paid fairly and consistently for their contribution to our collective success. To ensure fairness and transparency, positions at Equinor are evaluated using our global job architecture based on the position’s responsibilities, complexity, and impact, and regularly reviewed to ensure consistency and alignment across the organisation.# Important notes about the application processWe expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.# About EquinorEquinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We’re up for the challenge. Are you? #J-18808-Ljbffr

You will work cross-functionally with PMs, designers, backend engineers, and QA on an agile team and be responsible for design, implementation, testing, and production support. Collaborate with product and design to translate requirements into technical designs and estimates. Write clean, testable code and maintain a component-driven design system. Contribute to architecture and non-functional requirements (scalability, security, observability). Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals by optimizing bundles, rendering strategy, and caching. Implement and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E). Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, and delivery processes from story inception through production rollout. Support production services on a rotation basis and troubleshoot incidents to minimize downtime. Mentor teammates and help raise the team’s engineering standards. Strong experience with modern front-end tooling: bundlers (webpack/Vite/Gulp), state management, component libraries, and design systems. Proven ability to deliver features used in production and own them through lifecycle. Proven experience using agentic AI tools (such Claude or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate front-end development workflows, including code generation, component building, and performance optimization. Ability to mentor team members on effective AI usage; establishing best practices, identifying high-leverage opportunities, and fostering a culture of thoughtful, responsible AI adoption across the engineering team. Experience embedding generative AI features directly into user-facing applications, such as intelligent interfaces, dynamic content generation, and LLM-powered experiences. Experience writing automated tests (Jest/React Testing Library, Cypress or similar). Solid understanding of web performance optimization, SEO fundamentals, and accessibility best practices. Familiarity with secure development practices and basic security testing concepts. Experience working in agile teams and collaborating across disciplines. vagas.description: Senior Software Engineer (Github) - IC5 - 2026 About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. About the team The GitHub Governance team is one of the highest‑leverage teams in ETS. It decides — and operationalizes — how ten thousand Nubankers interact with GitHub, how repositories are governed, how access is granted and revoked, how vulnerabilities are surfaced and triaged, and how the platform serves as the substrate for AI‑assisted development at Nubank. The team's mandate touches every engineer in the company and every InfoSec, IAM, and Datasec partner that depends on the platform. The team is currently four people, holding the platform's active mandate: KPMG audit obligations, EMU (Enterprise Managed Users) migration, rollouts including Copilot Code Review, vibe‑coding profile design, the inactivity‑rule mechanism, and IP control work tied to the AI‑First posture. Every GitHub change at Nubank now routes through formal change management with InfoSec. About the role This role is a senior individual contributor on the GitHub Governance team, sharing technical ownership of the platform's surface with the existing senior engineers. The role is hands-on and execution-heavy: shipping platform changes, building automation, partnering with InfoSec on IAM and Datasec design decisions, and contributing senior judgment to the team's most exposed work. The role operates with autonomy, owning problems end-to-end, making technical calls within its scope without waiting for direction, and knowing when to elevate versus move forward. What the person will own As a Senior Software Engineer you will work across the team's portfolio, owning the slices that fit their depth and partnering on the rest. The current portfolio includes KPMG audit response and evidence collection, EMU migration (user‑profile migration is the active Wave 1, with the Identity Hub workaround as the path forward), rollouts including Copilot Code Review, vibe‑coding profile work and the connected guardrails, the inactivity‑rule design, and IP control mechanisms. Beyond execution, you will be a senior voice in the team's design discussions: architecture decisions, integration patterns with Identity Hub, ITSec/IAM/Datasec touchpoints, and the cross‑pack discussions with Coding Tools, AI Enablement, and Enterprise Solutions. You will be one of the engineers shaping how GitHub‑change governance works in practice at Nubank. This role will also serve as a technical partner in shaping the team's GitHub platform strategy, working alongside the PM to evaluate GitHub's product roadmap, anticipate how upcoming features affect Nubank's governance model. What we are looking for Must-haves Demonstrated depth administering GitHub Enterprise at scale (10,000+ users), including EMU (Enterprise Managed Users), organization and repo‑level policy design, and rulesets. Hands‑on experience with GitHub Copilot administration and rollout at an organizational level. Proficiency with the GitHub API and automation via GitHub Actions, including building or maintaining CODEOWNERS structures and branch protection patterns at scale. Working knowledge of GitHub audit logs and the ability to trace a policy decision through to its downstream effects on users, repositories, audit trails, and connected systems. Prior experience operating within a regulated engineering organization, with working knowledge of how InfoSec, IAM, and Datasec functions interact with a platform engineering team. Track record of working cross‑functionally with security leadership, tooling/enablement teams, and engineering stakeholders — writing clearly, pushing back constructively, and building trust quickly across functions without formal authority over those teams. Nice‑to‑have Experience supporting or shaping an organization's AI‑adoption strategy as it intersects with developer tooling and platform policy (e.g., Copilot governance, AI‑assisted coding guardrails). Familiarity with running GitHub Enterprise in a multi‑business‑unit or multi‑pack organizational structure, including navigating competing stakeholder priorities. Experience partnering directly with external auditors (e.g., Big Four firms) on platform‑level compliance evidence or remediation. Chance of earning equity at Nubank. Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte). NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program. Life Insurance. Medical Plan. NuLanguage – Language Course Program. Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses. Benefits Benefits include equity, healthcare plans, transportation benefits, language courses, and our NuCare assistance programs. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide. Responsibilities Define and drive the long‑term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability. Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C‑level and VPs) to shape the medium and long‑term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs. vagas.title: Reliability & Asset Integrity Engineer (Power Systems) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Ex[...]
vagas.description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. Job Overview We are seeking a Power Systems Reliability & Asset Integrity Engineer to join the Reliability & Asset Management Division (R&AMD) under Power Systems Projects & Technical Support Department (PSP&TSD). PSP&TSD provides HV Electrical Equipment Specialized technical support to Power Operations. R&AMD is responsible for administrating Power Systems engineering studies, equipment life cycle management, reliability assessments, equipment failure analysis, digital transformation, maintenance strategy reviews & enhancement to ensure safe, reliable and efficient power supply to all company’s hydrocarbon production & other support facilitates. Your primary role is to provide support, consultation, guidance and assistance to Power Systems operating areas and projects including engineering analysis and assuring adherence to Reliability & Asset Integrity Management standards. Key Responsibilities Develop a Reliability, Availability and Maintainability (RAM) model for the electrical substations and distribution network. Develop and align specific RCM process focused on equipment function (not just design), enabling targeted identification and mitigation of functional failures. Develop, manage, update and monitor implementation of short and long-term asset management policy, strategy, initiatives and work plans for power system asset and ensure alignment with overall company Strategic Asset Management Program. Manage PS owned Substations by deploying Asset Integrity Management System (AIMS) Program. Manage Power Systems HV Electrical Equipment Life Cycle Managements Process. Develop and manage single point of failure assessment to sustain Power Supply in case of equipment failure. Evaluate risk-based maintenance methodology based on likelihood and consequences. Provide technical guidance and tools in the area of risk and reliability assessment and management to work groups involved with distribution infrastructure replacement, substation infrastructure replacement, and transmission infrastructure replacement. Perform Asset failure trending and analysis. Identify repetitive failures and perform RCA to avoid reoccurrence of failures. Perform data analysis using techniques (APM, RCA, Six Sigma (6σ) etc.). Calculate and update the asset KPI’s. Issue reliability program monthly reports (MTBF, MTTR, bad actors, etc) updating the equipment health progress, and reporting failures and successes. Oversees PS assets performance and report PS technical KPIs for T&D assets. Utilize SAP Failure Reporting Analysis and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) to document and track unreliability events and reliability improvements opportunities. Provide technical information for field unreliability events backed up with equipment history & process data intended for area maintenance. Review the PM Defect Reports and evaluate corrective actions. Participate in developing, revising and tracking Asset Management strategies. Supervise the documentation and development of asset inventory for each class of assets, asset condition, level of service and performance, risk signature, maintenance strategies, repair/replacement models, financial forecasts, and tactical and work plans. As the successful candidate you will have: Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering working on High Voltage Electrical Equipment. Have a minimum of 8 years of experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical Industry or Power utility in the field of Power Systems Reliability & Asset Integrity Management. Familiar with reliability programs such as (RAM, RCM, RMS, MTBF, Bad actors, etc.) including SAP system or equivalent computerized systems. Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP), Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), TapRooT Analyst or 6 Sigma Certification is preferred. The ability to relocate to Dhahran, Saudi Arabia on a full time, expat basis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Would you like to deepen your knowledge of day-to-day offshore operations? As a Technical Coordinator, you will work closely with vessel crews and the onshore technical team, supporting maintenance activities, inspections, and operational reliability. If you enjoy solving technical challenges, working in a dynamic environment, and contributing to safe and efficient offshore operations, we’d love to hear from you. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil and reporting to the July 16th, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the process will be closed when the right candidate is found, thus we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Responsabilities As a Technical Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting the technical management of our offshore fleet by ensuring the effective execution of maintenance activities, vessel inspections, and technical follow-up of day-to-day operations. You will act as the primary link between vessel crews, suppliers, and the shore-based technical team, helping to ensure vessel reliability, safety, and operational readiness. In addition, this position will be responsible for: Conducting regular vessel visits, technical inspections, and onboard assessments to monitor equipment condition and maintenance standards; Following up preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure timely execution and quality of service; Assisting vessel management teams in troubleshooting technical issues and identifying effective solutions; Monitoring technical performance indicators and supporting initiatives to improve fleet reliability and availability; Coordinating service attendance, repairs, and maintenance campaigns together with vessel crews and contractors; Reviewing maintenance records, work orders, and technical reports to ensure proper documentation and compliance; Supporting dry-docking preparation, major overhauls, class surveys, and regulatory inspections when required; Ensuring compliance with company procedures, classification society requirements, flag state regulations, and client expectations; Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, maintenance optimization, and cost reduction, Providing technical feedback and recommendations to support strategic maintenance planning and fleet development initiatives. Requirements and Qualifications We believe our diversity is a vital strength, and we encourage you to bring your unique insights to help shape the future of our team and our company. For this role, it is necessary to: Hold a degree in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Naval Engineering, or a related technical field; Have previous experience in vessel maintenance, technical management, ship operations, or offshore support vessels; Demonstrate solid knowledge of marine machinery systems, propulsion equipment, auxiliary systems, and planned maintenance practices; Possess strong organizational and problem-solving skills; Be capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic operational environment; Have good communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with vessel crews, suppliers, and stakeholders; Be willing to travel frequently and conduct onboard visits as required, Have professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. vagas.title: Process Engineer - Utilities & Tank Farm-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
vagas.description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package. Job Overview We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands‑on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization. OESD’s technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally. Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on‑site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety. Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations. Provide hands‑on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports. Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly‑owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Deliver on‑demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start‑up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs. Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned. Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low‑hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification. Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering. Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring. Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno‑economic evaluations. Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment. Qualifications You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred. You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands‑on experience in handling refinery’s utilities. You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation. You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved. You will have in‑depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities. You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start‑up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems. You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics. You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management. #J-18808-Ljbffr

To provide necessary support for internal customers and external auditors. To seek ways to improve upon accounting and tax processes and procedures. To ensure the efficient implementation of the insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. To assist the FIFA27 Executive Director Administration and the FIFA Finance Division on special requests. To manage, supervise and motivate the Finance team and to provide effective guidance and leadership. When necessary to contribute to the daily financial tasks. vagas.title: Coordenador(a) Tributário
vagas.description: Sobre a Osklen Osklen é a expressão de um lifestyle definido pelo equilíbrio da vida urbana integrada à natureza, em que o orgânico e o tecnológico, o local e o global, o luxo e a simplicidade são conceitos complementares. Criada em 1989 por Oskar Metsavaht, artista, designer e ambientalista, a Osklen vem liderando o caminho de inovação na moda sustentável, se compromete com atitudes socioambientais positivas em parceria com o Instituto-E*, em prol do desenvolvimento humano sustentável, o que faz da marca referência no Brasil e internacionalmente por seu estilo autoral, inovação em design e pelo uso de matérias-primas desenvolvidas com base em critérios sociais, ambientais e econômicos, os e-fabrics. As coleções e projetos da Osklen reforçam a união dos pilares da arte, design, lifestyle e sustentabilidade, priorizando o pensamento sustentável através de materiais e processos de fabricação com menos impacto socioambiental possível. Valorização da diversidade Promovemos diversidade e inclusão em nossos processos seletivos, incentivando a candidatura de profissionais sem discriminação de raça, etnia, religião, cor, sexo, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero. Atividades Planejar, acompanhar e revisar a apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS, IPI, IBS e CBS); Garantir a entrega correta e dentro dos prazos das obrigações acessórias fiscais (Programa SPEDs/ GIA ST entre outras); Análise e interpretação/alterações na legislação tributária, orientando a equipe e as demais áreas da empresa; Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de planejamento tributário visando à otimização da carga fiscal, em conformidade com a legislação vigente; Coordenar processos de fiscalização, auditorias internas e externas e atendimento a órgãos fiscalizadores; Revisar cálculos tributários, conciliações contábeis e controles fiscais; Coordenar processos de recuperação de créditos tributários e compensações fiscais; Prestar suporte técnico às áreas contábil, financeira, jurídica e operacional em assuntos tributários; Liderar, desenvolver e avaliar o desempenho da equipe tributária, promovendo capacitação contínua; Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos fiscais, propondo automações e melhorias de controles internos; Assegurar a conformidade tributária da empresa, minimizando riscos fiscais e contingências; Coordenar os projetos relacionados à implementação da Reforma Tributária. Requisitos Necessários Sólido conhecimento da legislação tributária brasileira, com atuação em tributos diretos e indiretos (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS e IPI); Vivência com apuração de tributos, obrigações acessórias (SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, ECF, ECD, GIA/ST, entre outras) e revisão de cálculos tributários; Experiência em atendimento a auditorias e fiscalizações, bem como interação com órgãos fiscalizadores; Conhecimento em conciliações fiscais e contábeis, controles internos e compliance tributário; Capacidade de interpretar alterações na legislação e avaliar seus impactos no negócio; Conhecimento avançado em Excel e experiência com sistemas ERP (Preferencialmente Protheus). Requisitos Desejáveis Experiência em empresas dos segmentos de varejo, indústria ou moda; Vivência com planejamento tributário e recuperação de créditos fiscais; Experiência em projetos de implementação da Reforma Tributária; Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI e automação de processos fiscais. Formação Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Horário De segunda a sexta, 8:30h por dia (Formato híbrido, sendo terça, quarta e quinta presencial – Rio Comprido/RJ). O que oferecemos Assistência médica e odontológica Desconto em produtos da marca Incentivo ao desenvolvimento e treinamentos Flexibilidade de horário no dia a dia Day off no aniversário para celebrar seu dia PLR Vale refeição/alimentação Vale-transporte e van de apoio ao colaborador Parcerias e convênios exclusivos (saúde, bem-estar, educação, estética e outros) Seguro de vida #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista de Credenciamento Pleno- Operadora de Saúde
vagas.description: Qualificações Ensino Superior completo ou cursando Experiência em mercado de saúde Sólidos conhecimentos sobre Técnicas de Atendimento ao cliente (área Saúde) e Órgãos Reguladores ANS Pacote Microsoft Office, especificamente Excel e PowerPoint Responsabilidades Garantir a satisfação da nossa rede credenciada (Hospitais, Laboratórios, Clínicas e Médicos) no que se refere ao prestador e cliente. Manter relacionamento com os credenciados, através do desenvolvimento de um cronograma de relacionamento, com o objetivo de facilitar a operação da gestão de atendimento ao beneficiário. Garantir boas práticas médicas, alinhando as expectativas da empresa em relação à solicitação dos credenciados, estreitando relacionamento. Acompanhar e analisar a composição de despesas de cada credenciado, com base nos procedimentos solicitados, a fim de abrir negociação de composição de custos, para redefinição de tabela de preços e/ou reposicionamento do credenciado junto à estrutura de produtos da empresa. Auferir pacotes verificando custos e necessidades das propostas para ampliação dos procedimentos contratados, a fim de garantir o valor efetivo. Analisar oportunidades de novos negócios junto ao credenciado, buscando a redução de custos/sinistro. Receber e analisar irregularidades ou outras demandas para melhorar o atendimento, encaminhando as respostas às áreas envolvidas (ANS, Comercial, Contas Médicas, Auditoria e Técnica), a fim de otimizar o tempo de resposta à questão levantada e/ou problema evidenciado. Conhecer e manter-se atualizado com relação às regulamentações da Agência Nacional de Saúde (RN´s, Instruções Normativas), visando a adequação de contratos e contratação de novos procedimentos. Desenvolver e contratar novos credenciados, analisando minutas contratuais, extensões, procedimentos cobertos e formalizando as negociações, mantendo o sistema de informação atualizado. Praticar e disseminar a missão, visão e valores, bem como as responsabilidades individuais de segurança e privacidade da informação do Grupo. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: GERENTE FARMACEUTICO & DIGITAL - RIO DE JANEIRO/RJ
vagas.description: MAIS QUE MERCADO O Grupo Carrefour Brasil é o maior varejista do país, presente em todos os estados e atendendo mais de 60 milhões de clientes por mês. Atuamos em diferentes formatos como Atacadão, Carrefour Varejo, Sam’s Club, Banco Carrefour e Carrefour Property oferecendo soluções diversificadas para um Brasil tão plural. Com 130 mil colaboradores, temos o propósito de oferecer alimentação acessível e de qualidade a todos, enquanto contribuímos para uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável. No Carrefour, trabalhamos diariamente a cultura do respeito e da equidade. A valorização da diversidade é um compromisso para o Carrefour, por isso, encorajamos a candidatura e damos oportunidade a profissionais diversos, sejam Mulheres, Negros (as), Pessoas LGBTQIA+, Pessoas com deficiência ou Pessoas em situação de refúgio. Também reconhecemos a importância da diversidade geracional e temos orgulho em promover oportunidades para profissionais 50+, que fortalecem nosso time com suas experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, cada pessoa pode evoluir em sua jornada profissional. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento, com oportunidades de crescimento que vão de posições operacionais até cargos de liderança. Venha crescer com a gente e fazer parte dessa história! DO DISCURSO À PRÁTICA Gerenciar a operação da drogaria, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação vigente, das diretrizes corporativas e das Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas, garantindo qualidade, segurança, rentabilidade e excelência e cordialidade no atendimento ao cliente. Principais Responsabilidades Atuar como Responsável Técnico pela farmácia, garantindo o cumprimento das normas da ANVISA, CRF, Vigilância Sanitária e demais legislações aplicáveis. Assegurar a aplicação das Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas (BPF) e dos processos de garantia da qualidade. Monitorar e manter a loja preparada para auditorias, fiscalizações e inspeções sanitárias. Informar ao Gerente Regional e ao setor de Licenciamento sobre ausência ou alteração do quadro farmacêutico. Assegurar condições adequadas de armazenamento, conservação, dispensação e controle de validade dos medicamentos. Liderar, desenvolver e motivar a equipe, promovendo ambiente respeitoso, inclusivo e alinhado aos valores corporativos. Delegar tarefas e assegurar o cumprimento das atividades designadas. Conduzir reuniões periódicas e treinamentos técnicos e operacionais. Participar dos processos de admissão, promoção e desligamento em conjunto com o Gerente Regional e com aprovação da diretoria. Repassar ao time as diretrizes e comunicações oriundas da Matriz e Gerência Regional. Informar prontamente desvios de conduta ao Gerente Regional. Reportar-se ao Gerente Regional responsável pela drogaria. Atender às demandas enviadas pelos departamentos da Matriz. Responsabilizar-se pelo lançamento de atestados, afastamentos e controle de ponto no sistema. Realizar assinatura e arquivamento das folhas de ponto dos colaboradores. Acompanhar a concorrência e propor ações estratégicas para fortalecimento da unidade. Priorizar o atendimento ao cliente com cordialidade, eficiência e humanização, promovendo experiência ética e de qualidade. Realizar acompanhamento de vendas e indicadores, promovendo ações para alcance das metas. Desenvolver estratégias para aumento de ticket médio e rentabilidade da unidade. Atuar em parceria com demais áreas da loja para potencializar resultados. Requisitos Graduação em Farmácia. Registro ativo no CRF. Experiência prévia em gestão de drogarias ou varejo farmacêutico. Conhecimento em legislação sanitária e Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas. Conhecimento intermediário em Excel e PowerPoint. Se identificou? Inscreva-se e vamos juntos mudar o mundo através da alimentação! #J-18808-Ljbffr

Na Spassu, estamos com um projeto incrível no ar — e ele está prontíssimo para receber profissionais com aquele algo a mais. Responsabilidades Apoiar a fiscalização na promoção, fiscalização e gestão da saúde ocupacional dos trabalhadores, além da análise de documentos e indicadores relacionados à segurança e saúde no ambiente de trabalho. Apoiar na divulgação das orientações de SMS às gerências e em contratadas, divulgando orientações de SMS com foco específico em saúde ocupacional, incluindo prevenção de doenças, ergonomia e campanhas de saúde, baseando-se nos parâmetros do PCMSO e das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs). Realizar análise técnica dos impactos de condições de trabalho na saúde dos trabalhadores e propor ações corretivas alinhadas às diretrizes do PCMSO e do Ministério da Saúde. Apoiar a fiscalização no cumprimento de requisitos legais relacionados à saúde ocupacional, como PPRA, PCMSO, ASO e CAT. Apoiar a fiscalização no levantamento, análise e disponibilização de dados de indicadores de SMS ligados à saúde, monitorando indicadores específicos de saúde ocupacional, como afastamentos por doenças, frequência de exames médicos e condições ergonômicas, e garantir a manutenção dos dados em sistemas corporativos. Atender auditorias de SMS e Gestão Ambiental, e investigações de acidentes/incidentes, com foco na saúde dos trabalhadores, analisando impactos físicos e psicológicos relacionados e propor medidas preventivas e corretivas. Fiscalizar tecnicamente contratos, garantindo que as contratadas cumpram requisitos específicos de saúde ocupacional, como realização de exames médicos periódicos e ações de promoção à saúde. Realizar Listas de Verificação (LVs) de SMS detalhadas, abrangendo conformidade com o PCMSO, ASO e outros documentos médicos relacionados à saúde dos trabalhadores. Desenvolver relatórios técnicos ou apresentações sobre SMS com foco em saúde ocupacional, incluindo análise de dados médicos, campanhas de saúde e pareceres sobre conformidade com o PCMSO e normas de saúde. Utilizar as ferramentas de gestão de Saúde e SMS da Petrobras, tais como Audicomp, SIGEM, SISPEN, SALV2, AUDICOMP, SISIN, DDSMS, DATAHIDRO, SCR, SMSNet e SIGA, para garantir o monitoramento e atualização de informações relacionadas à saúde dos trabalhadores. Avaliar e comentar documentos médicos e ocupacionais, como PCMSO, ASO e CAT, com base em conhecimentos específicos de saúde ocupacional. Participar de reuniões técnicas, elaborar minutas e pareceres técnicos sobre saúde ocupacional, incluindo indicadores de saúde, conformidade com o PCMSO e desempenho das contratadas. Garantir a aplicação de ações do PCMSO, como a realização de exames médicos ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos e demissionais) e a implementação de medidas preventivas. Acompanhar casos de afastamentos por doenças ocupacionais, realizar intervenções preventivas e propor ações corretivas para preservar a saúde dos trabalhadores. Implementar campanhas de promoção à saúde ocupacional. Requisitos Graduação em Enfermagem; Pós-Graduação lato sensu (especialização) em Enfermagem do Trabalho. Experiência Desejável: 06 anos ou mais em atividades relacionadas com atuação na indústria de energia (óleo, gás, termoelétricas, entre outras), química/petroquímica, multinacionais-certificadoras ou montagem industrial de grande ou médio porte. vagas.description: Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding. Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powership™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes. We are looking for an Senior FSRU Operations Engineer to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? Candidates combining an engineering degree with seagoing FSRU/LNG tanker experience will be prioritized. >8Years (minimum 4 years directly in FSRU or LNG terminal operations) Advanced English (mandatory) | Portuguese — working proficiency minimum (mandatory). MS Office (advanced); SAP PM/MM; MS Project (desirable); Power BI (desirable)STCW Basic Safety Training (desirable); GWO (desirable); OPITO LNG or SIGTTO gas industry certification will be a strong plus. Strong analytical and report‑writing skills in English and Portuguese. Proven ability to manage interfaces with multiple stakeholders (regulatory authorities, charterers, OEMs, Class societies). Ability to interpret and operationalize BBC/OSA contractual clauses. Experience with Brazilian energy/maritime regulators (ANP, ANTAQ, Brazilian Navy) strongly preferred. Willingness to travel to vessel/terminal sites as required. WHAT AWAITS YOU? Support with local needs for the new FSRUs readiness programme ahead of first gas‑out, following commissioning activities between the vessel crew, engineering teams, and client/offtaker representatives. Develop and manage the Pre‑Operations Checklist, punch lists, and start‑up procedures in alignment with BBC and OSA contract conditions. Oversee preparation and submission of all documentation required by ANP, ANTAQ, and Brazilian Navy prior to FSRU commercial operations commencement. Support preparation for mooring, berthing, and jetty/buoy interface assessments and ensure FSRU is ready to meet contractual operational start date (COD). Track and report pre‑operations milestones, flagging risks to Senior Leadership in a timely manner. Serve as the onshore focal point for daily FSRU operational activities, maintaining continuous interface with the vessel’s Senior Officers (Master, Chief Engineer, Gas Officer) and onshore management. Monitor send‑out rates, regasification performance, boil‑off gas (BOG) management, and LNG inventory, ensuring alignment with contracted dispatch schedules and offtaker requirements. Supervise planned and unplanned maintenance activities, ensuring operational continuity is preserved and any downtime is managed within BBC/OSA contractual allowances. Supervise LNG cargo receiving operations, including Ship‑to‑Ship (STS) transfers: pre‑transfer planning, compatibility assessments, authority approvals (ANP Authorization, ANTAQ), and post‑transfer reporting. Ensure continuous compliance with ANP Resolution 810/2020 (Safety Management for LNG terminals/FSRUs), ANP Resolution 982/2022 (gas quality standards), and all applicable ANP authorization conditions for FSRU operations. Support and follow‑up all ANTAQ requirements are met for the FSRU as a port facility and maritime installation, including ISPS compliance, operational safety, and berthing/mooring approvals. vagas.title: Field Service Engr II
vagas.description: Job Summary Honeywell/Compressor Control Corporation (CCC) uses its values of integrity, teamwork, communication, knowledge, and safety to deliver reliable products and excellent service to our customers around the world. We strive to produce and disperse solutions for critical turbomachinery control applications that result in tangible economic benefits to every customer through both internal and external collaboration and communication. The CCC Engineer will be expected to provide technical expertise and consultancy at customer sites to commission, troubleshoot, engineer, operate, configure and optimize CCC products and systems at customer sites. Additionally, the Engineer will advise CCC customers in specific, appropriate product usage. Key Responsibilities Using independent judgement, knowledge, and expertise to perform Pre-commissioning activities including system checkout, instrumentation calibration, loop checks, and communication testing. Test and perform tuning including machinery testing, control loop tuning and troubleshooting within the larger customer process. Apply advanced mathematical concepts and operations to effectively complete specific projects and tasks. Thermodynamic calculations and analysis of machine performance. Provide remote technical support, systems engineering support and troubleshooting. Transfer technology knowledge to Customer operating and engineering staff through training sessions. Collaborate with departments cross functionally to support the entire Lifecycle of our products and customer experience. Complete required administrative tasks (expenses, reports, etc.) and aftermarket support. Respond to change productively and handle other duties as required. Follow all company safety policies and procedures. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from a four-year college or university required (mechanical, electrical, turbomachinery). Minimum 5-10 years of previous work experience with turbo machinery control systems (Compressors, Steam / Gas Turbines, Expanders, Generators) and Process control preferred. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Strong customer focus and ability to build and maintain relationships. WE VALUE Strong leadership and mentoring skills. Continuous learning mindset and willingness to stay updated with industry advancements. Results-oriented approach and ability to drive projects to successful completion. Knowledge of PLC such as Rockwell Allen-Bradley, SIEMENS S-7, etc. About Us Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments - powered by our Honeywell Forge software - that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Technical Account Manager
vagas.description: Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida. Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con base en Rio de Janeiro o São Pablo, Brasil, con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar el relacionamiento técnico comercial con partners dentro del sector telecom con alcance global. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades de negocio sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización. Principales Responsabilidades: Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio: Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa. Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs), trabajando junto con los partners en el seguimiento. Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing"). Influir en conjunto con el team del partner, en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente. Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar) Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico‑comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall, acompañando la prospección hecha por los partners. Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente. Relación y Evangelización: Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C‑Level). Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades. Continuidad Post‑Venta (Value Delivery): Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas. Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente. Requisitos Excluyentes: Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre‑Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales. Trabajo previo en oportunidades comerciales a través de partners/integradores o resellers. Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier‑1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvil, Cloud, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS. Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente. Idiomas: Dominio fluido de español e inglés. Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On‑premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands‑on). Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación. Disponibilidad: Para viajar, dado que se trata de un rol global para todo el ecosistema de partners/integradores y resellers de Iquall. Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier‑1, 2 y 3 de la región. Experiencia previa trabajando en integradores y partners. Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile. Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios. Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía. Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel. Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia. Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Vivência em estudos de tempo e caminho, sequenciamento construtivo e otimização de recursos. Conhecimento em Power BI, automação de processos e análise avançada de dados. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Senior Geophysicist
vagas.description: O (a) Geosolutions Geophysicist é responsável por contribuir com expertise em diversas técnicas de aquisição e processamento, bem como em geofísica, além de possuir entendimento de interpretação e inversão. Responsabilidades Interagir de forma consistente com clientes e orientá-los quanto aos parâmetros de processamento. Processar dados utilizando as tecnologias e softwares apropriados. Garantir que os dados processados sejam entregues aos clientes dentro do prazo. Definir, construir e submeter testes, interpretar resultados, fornecer recomendações de parâmetros e sugerir testes adicionais, quando necessário. Validar a precisão e a eficiência de todas as sequências de testes e produção. Manter-se atualizado sobre avanços em processamento sísmico, comunicação e técnicas de transferência de dados. Investigar e reportar problemas encontrados durante o processamento de dados sísmicos. Mentorar profissionais juniores. Auxiliar o Líder de Projeto na gestão diária de projetos e equipe, incluindo picking de velocidades e controle de qualidade. Organizar e delegar tarefas. Prever necessidades de recursos e reportar o status dos projetos. Arquivar projetos. Requisitos Mínimos Graduação em Geofísica, Geologia ou áreas de Geociências, com CREA ativo. Experiência em Sísmica & Subsuperfície: interpretação sísmica 2D/3D (horizontes, falhas, atributos), modelagem de velocidade e imageamento em profundidade (ex: FWI), conversão tempo-profundidade, análise AVO/AVA, inversão sísmica e rock physics. Experiência em Processamento Sísmico: processamento de sinais (domínio do tempo e profundidade), migração sísmica, controle de qualidade (QC) de dados e workflows, desenvolvimento e validação de sequências de processamento. Experiência com softwares de processamento sísmico, geofísica & interpretação, GIS e modelagem. Inglês avançado (mandatório). SLB offers equal employment opportunity. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista de Departamento Pessoal Sênior - TOTVS RM LABORE
vagas.description: O Grupo Kobe Elija é referência consolidada no setor automotivo, operando com excelência as concessionárias da Honda (Rio Tókio e Narita), Audi e Ducati. Estamos em busca de um profissional técnico, resiliente e com alto nível de organização para integrar nossa equipe de RH como Analista de DP Sênior. Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil resolutivo, analítico e com forte bagagem em estruturação de processos. Se você é Especialista no sistema RM Labore , possui visão de dono e se sente motivado por desafios que envolvem transformar ambientes dinâmicos, essa vaga é para você. Você será a referência técnica da área, responsável por garantir a excelência do processamento da folha de pagamento de ponta a ponta e por liderar a parametrização e melhoria contínua do nosso sistema de gestão. Principais Responsabilidades Processamento e fechamento completo da folha de pagamento, cálculo de comissões, premiações, pensões, envio de arquivo bancário e encargos trabalhistas. Rotinas de admissão, controle e cálculo de férias, rescisões, complementares e diferenças salariais por CCT. Recolhimento pontual de tributos, envio de obrigações acessórias, relatórios da DIRF, e Relatório de Transparência e Igualdade Salarial. Contabilização da folha, conciliação e provisões trabalhistas, com suporte e interface com contabilidade. Parametrização, atualizações, correções de fórmulas e implantações de módulos do RM Labore, garantindo aproveitamento máximo da ferramenta. Identificar gargalos operacionais, desenhar fluxos e implementar melhorias, criar histórico, manuais de processos e rotinas estruturadas. Prestar apoio técnico em demandas trabalhistas, fiscalizações, auditorias administrativas da área e atendimento interno aos colaboradores. Requisitos Mandatórios Domínio avançado do RM Labore (TOTVS): experiência prática em operação, parametrização, regras de negócio e inteligência do sistema. Sólida experiência em nível Sênior no DP, com domínio técnico da legislação trabalhista e rotinas de eSocial. Expertise em remuneração variável: cálculos complexos envolvendo comissões e premiações. Domínio em rotinas de contabilização, conciliação e provisões de DP. Excel avançado: relatórios, fórmulas complexas, Procv/Xlookup, Se, tabelas dinâmicas e cruzamento de bases de dados. Equilíbrio entre visão estratégica de processos e execução operacional diária da folha. Diferenciais Experiência prévia em processos de centralização de DP, migração ou implantação de sistemas de folha. Vivência no segmento de varejo ou comércio de grande fluxo, onde variáveis de comissão são intensas. Soft Skills Resiliência e inteligência emocional: foco, precisão técnica e entrega de prazos em ambientes dinâmicos. Perfil construtor e organização: criar ordem no caos, documentar processos e estruturar fluxos de trabalho. vagas.title: MSF Access Regional Pharmacist America Hub
vagas.description: Job Title: MSF Access Regional Pharmacist America Hub Contract Type: Short-term contract Duration: 12 months Working Time: Full time Starting Date: ASAP Deadline to apply: July 10, 2026 Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Reporting to: Head of Americas Hub Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract. I. BACKGROUND MSF INTERNATIONA Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency medical assistance to people affected by conflict, epidemics, disasters, or exclusion from healthcare. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 27 associations and 18 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information, and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF ACCESS Access to Products for Healthcare is critical to MSF's Social Mission. It refers to the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness, and quality of products for healthcare for the populations MSF assists and their communities. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve Access in past decades through the work of MSF’s Access Campaign. In 2023, the MSF International Board approved the set-up of a new organisational model for Access work in MSF, building upon the works carried out by Access Campaign. MSF Access team is transitioned from this process and has the responsibility of analysing and developing initiatives to address technical and structural challenges in ensuring equitable access to quality assured, affordable, adaptive and appropriate medical tools needed in MSF settings and beyond. The newly established MSF Access structure replaces the former Access Campaign with a broader scope of work, operating through five strategic regional hubs: Dakar, Senegal: West and Central Africa. Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: The Americas. Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia: Asia and Oceania. Nairobi, Kenya: Eastern and Southern Africa. Brussels, Belgium: Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. In MSF Access team’s strategic plan and the annual plan 2026, enhancing strategic approach towards evolving regulatory landscapes and their impact on access in MSF settings has been included as one priority area for analysis. In the Americas, local and regional production and innovation, combined with regulatory convergence and harmonization, are increasingly central to ensuring sustainable access to essential health products. At the same time, regulatory complexity, fragmented approval pathways and limited sourcing options continue to constrain MSF operations and public health systems. This position strengthens MSF Access’ regional capacity to analyse, influence and engage on production, innovation and regulatory agendas, ensuring they are explicitly oriented toward access and public health needs, including MSF operational priorities. II. PLACEMENT The Regional Pharmacist is part of the MSF Access Americas Hub and reports to the Head of the Americas Region. The position works in close collaboration with the Americas regional advisors and has a strong functional link with the Analysis Department of the MSF Access team, a multidisciplinary group of experts working on medical, pharmaceutical, legal and policy issues related to access to health products. III. OBJECTIVE OF THE POSITION The objective of the position is to strengthen MSF Access’ understanding of local and regional production in the Americas, with a particular focus on how regulatory frameworks, harmonization initiatives, reliance models, policies affecting the importation, exportation and regional circulation of health products, and mechanisms designed to incentivize local and regional production create opportunities or pose risks for equitable access to quality‑assured medicines, diagnostics and vaccines, including how regulation shapes markets and access, influences market dynamics through systemic barriers and enablers, and impacts equity and the availability of essential health products across countries in the region. Through in‑depth regulatory and policy analysis, the position aims to generate actionable evidence to inform MSF operations, advocacy and engagement on local production, regional supply strategies, pooled procurement and other collaborative purchasing mechanisms, as well as broader efforts to improve sustainable and equitable access to health technologies across the region. IV. MAIN ACTIVITIES Understand existing production, innovation and regulatory landscapes (diagnostic core) Monitor and analyse existing national and regional production and innovation initiatives related to medicines, vaccines and diagnostics, including developments concerning: Technology transfer and licensing initiatives Public and regional manufacturing capacity Regional collaboration and coordination platforms Funding mechanisms and industrial policy instruments Regulatory approval pathways, market authorization processes, importation and exportation frameworks, procurement mechanisms, and reliance/harmonization mechanisms, and their interaction with market structures, shaping both the feasibility of local and regional production and its impact on equitable access, including product availability, pricing, affordability, and supply security Conduct desk reviews and ongoing analysis of existing regional and national policies, strategies and initiatives related to local and regional production and innovation. Map and analyse regulatory landscapes, harmonization initiatives and regulatory reliance models relevant to medicines, diagnostics and vaccines in the Americas, including key international, regional and selected national initiatives. 2. Identify barriers, risks and opportunities from an access perspective Assess how regulatory frameworks, harmonization initiatives, regulatory practices, procurement approaches and production incentive mechanisms influence: Equitable access to quality‑assured medical products The feasibility, sustainability and scale‑up of local and regional production Market shaping dynamics, including systemic barriers and enablers affecting access, affordability, and availability of essential health technologies Identify how regulatory and market-related constraints translate into inequities in access, including delayed approvals, fragmented regulatory systems, and limited reliance mechanisms across countries. Drawing on MSF operational experience in the Americas, analyse where existing production and regulatory approaches fail or succeed in delivering affordable, quality‑assured and appropriate products to MSF settings and underserved populations. 3. Translate analysis into access-oriented frameworks and MSF positioning Develop and maintain an access-oriented policy and analytical framework for public and local/regional production and innovation, explicitly grounded in: Public health priorities Equity and affordability Quality assurance MSF operational and humanitarian needs In collaboration with MSF Access team produce periodic analytical updates, technical notes and internal briefs to inform MSF Access strategic discussions and decision-making. Provide technical pharmaceutical input to MSF positions, policy documents and advocacy strategies related to local and regional production, innovation, regulatory pathways, procurement approaches and regional collaboration mechanisms, ensuring these are grounded in evidence generated through the diagnostic and analytical work, and explicitly incorporating analysis of how regulatory and market dynamics affect equitable access, affordability and availability of essential medical products in MSF operational contexts. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks, including Human Resources, and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these selection procedures. Qualifications and Knowledge Degree in Pharmacy (mandatory). Solid knowledge of access to medicines and health technologies, including issues related to availability, affordability, quality and appropriateness. Understanding of local and regional production and innovation ecosystems, including public and private manufacturing models. Knowledge of regulatory systems for medicines, vaccines and diagnostics, including regulatory approval pathways, quality assurance, importation and exportation frameworks, and regulatory reliance or harmonization mechanisms. Familiarity with pharmaceutical policy, market dynamics and procurement is an asset. Basic understanding of intellectual property, licensing and technology transfer in the context of access to health products is an asset. Strong interest in public-health-driven and access-oriented approaches to local production and innovation. Commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and access-to-care mission. Professional Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in pharmacy, pharmaceutical policy, access to medicines, regulatory affairs, public health analysis or related fields. Proven experience working in Latin American countries Experience related to local or regional production, regulation, procurement or access initiatives is a strong asset. Prior experience with MSF or other humanitarian, public health or non-profit organisation is an asset. Skills and Competencies Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify barriers, risks and opportunities. Excellent writing skills, including the ability to produce clear analytical briefs and technical notes for internal audiences. Ability to translate complex regulatory, production and policy issues into access-focused insights. Strong communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary and multicultural environments. Ability to work independently and autonomously, while coordinating closely with regional and international teams. Capacity to manage multiple analytical tasks and deliver outputs within agreed timelines. Proficiency in spoken and written English, Spanish, and Portuguese Frequent international travel. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Shorebase Coordinator
vagas.description: This position will be responsible for managing the operational readiness and performance of BW Energy shorebase facilities, ensuring safe and reliable logistics support to offshore operations. Serving as the primary focal point between the shorebase and offshore assets, the coordinator will oversee warehousing, cargo handling, and vessel activities while supervising third-party service providers. Additionally, the role involves driving a strong safety culture, monitoring operational KPIs, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders to optimize efficiency during drilling, production, and subsea project phases. Responsibilities Responsible for the management, operational readiness and performance of BW Energy shorebase facilities, ensuring safe, efficient and reliable logistics support to offshore operations. Act as the primary logistics focal point between the shorebase and offshore assets, ensuring alignment of logistics priorities and operational requirements. Participate in daily operational meetings with the FPSO, Wellhead Platform, Drilling Rig and other project stakeholders to support the execution of Project activities. Ensure shorebase readiness to support drilling, production, subsea, construction and project activities throughout all project phases. Monitor and oversee all shorebase activities, including warehousing, yard operations, cargo handling, material staging, vessel support and logistics service providers. Ensure efficient planning and execution of shorebase logistics activities, supporting offshore operations through adequate allocation of resources and services. Monitor vessel activities during shorebase operations, including berth allocation, cargo operations, bunkering activities, water supply and coordination of additional port services when required. Supervise and monitor logistics service providers operating within the shorebase, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, operational requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Monitor shorebase operational performance through KPIs, reports and operational controls, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Support the monitoring of logistics contracts, service measurements, proformas and operational invoices related to shorebase activities. Promote and reinforce a strong safety culture across all shorebase operations and contractor activities. Ensure the proper implementation of emergency response plans, waste management procedures and oil spill contingency requirements related to onshore logistics activities. Identify and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency, service quality and resource utilization. Ensure proper interface between shorebase operations, marine logistics, materials management, offshore units and logistics service providers. Monitor operational non-conformities, incidents and service deviations, ensuring appropriate reporting and follow-up of corrective actions. Support audits, inspections and compliance activities related to shorebase operations and logistics services. Ensure that relevant requirements of the Management System are used as the terms of reference for the activities controlled. Undertake training relevant to the position requirements. On-the-job training of colleagues and trainees. Assist in any other work specified by Department Head. Education Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, Maritime Studies or a related field is desirable. Experience Relevant experience in offshore logistics, shorebase operations, port operations or similar logistics leadership positions. Proven experience supporting offshore drilling, production, subsea, construction or development projects. Previous experience managing logistics service providers, shorebase contracts and offshore support operations. Knowledge Knowledge of offshore logistics, shorebase operations and port logistics. Knowledge of offshore drilling, production, subsea and construction support operations. Knowledge of logistics contracts, contractor management and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Knowledge of cargo handling, vessel support and shorebase logistics activities. Knowledge of HSE requirements applicable to logistics and shorebase operations. Experience with ERP systems, preferably IFS or equivalent systems. Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken. Advanced Microsoft Excel knowledge. #J-18808-Ljbffr
